AI.result: 在VLA-Arena上，相同调用预算下成功率高于其他不确定性基线，墙钟开销低，且更稳定地区分成功与失败回合；相比非自适应基线具有更优的代价-成功率权衡，通过单一阈值变化即可描出完整工作曲线，并在同等成功率下大幅减少VLM调用。真机实验同样呈现该权衡：相对最强固定间隔基线减少75%通用专家调用，且成功率更高。
AI.conclusion: 预测不确定性为高效VLA控制中的自适应推理提供了实用判据。

title: GeoBridge-VLA: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models encode semantic information from vision-language pretraining, but manipulation also requires precise spatial reasoning. We present GeoBridge-VLA, a two-stage method for learning geometric features from a pretrained VLA's frozen visual encoder and using them for action prediction. Stage I trains a feature bridge and geometry decoder with depth supervision. Stage II freezes these modules and trains a gated residual interface together with the action-side projections and action expert. The residual augments the existing visual tokens without adding a second image encoder or increasing the token count. Deployment requires RGB, robot state, and language, but no depth observations. Under matched evaluation conditions, GeoBridge-VLA achieves 70.9% success on LIBERO, compared with 60.0% for SmolVLA. Disabling the residual in the same trained checkpoint reduces success from 70.90% to 69.85%, with mixed effects across suites. On a physical ROBOTIS OMY robot, GeoBridge-VLA succeeds in 148 of 200 trials (74.0%) across four tasks, compared with 108 of 200 (54.0%) for SmolVLA.

AI.tldr: 提出 GeoBridge-VLA：两阶段从预训练 VLA 冻结视觉编码器中学习几何特征并注入动作预测，LIBERO 成功率 70.9%（SmolVLA 60.0%），真机 74.0%（SmolVLA 54.0%），部署仅需 RGB、机器人状态与语言。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型继承了视觉-语言预训练的语义信息，但操作任务还需要精确的空间/几何推理能力，而现有 VLA 的视觉编码器对此表征不足。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：第一阶段用深度监督训练特征桥（feature bridge）与几何解码器；第二阶段冻结上述模块，训练门控残差接口（gated residual interface）、动作侧投影与动作专家（action expert）。残差在既有视觉 token 上做增强，不引入第二个图像编码器、不增加 token 数量。
AI.result: 在匹配评测条件下，LIBERO 成功率 70.9%（SmolVLA 为 60.0%）；同一训练检查点中禁用残差后成功率由 70.90% 降至 69.85%，各 suite 效果不一。ROBOTIS OMY 真机上四任务 200 次试验成功 148 次（74.0%），SmolVLA 为 108/200（54.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 从冻结视觉编码器中提取几何特征并以门控残差方式注入动作预测可行且有效，部署时无需深度观测，仅需 RGB、机器人状态与语言，在仿真与真机上均显著优于 SmolVLA。

title: SPACE-CLIPv2: Decoding Local Geometry from Frozen CLIP for Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Vision-language foundation models such as CLIP provide strong semantic representations, but their patch tokens are not directly optimized for dense metric geometry. SPACE-CLIP showed that frozen CLIP features can support monocular depth estimation through layer-group feature fusion, yet it leaves open how neighboring CLIP tokens should be combined to recover fine local structure. We present SPACE-CLIPv2, a frozen-backbone depth decoder that aggregates fixed local neighborhoods in CLIP token space. At selected decoder stages, the model samples a fixed token stencil, predicts aggregation weights, and injects the resulting response through a gated residual update. A token-space high-pass branch further preserves shallow local contrast. On NYU Depth V2, SPACE-CLIPv2 improves over a matched SPACE-CLIP baseline, while five-seed experiments consistently favor fixed over learned-offset sampling. Zero-shot iBims-1 evaluation further improves boundary and planar-geometry measures. These results support constrained local token aggregation as a practical mechanism for decoding geometry from frozen CLIP representations.

AI.tldr: SPACE-CLIPv2：冻结 CLIP 主干、在 token 空间做固定局部邻域聚合的深度解码器，NYU Depth V2 优于 SPACE-CLIP 基线，五种子实验显示固定采样优于可学习偏移采样。
AI.motivation: CLIP 等视觉-语言基础模型具备强语义表征，但其 patch token 并未针对稠密度量几何（单目深度）优化。SPACE-CLIP 已证明冻结 CLIP 特征可经层组特征融合支持深度估计，但"相邻 CLIP token 应如何组合以恢复细粒度局部结构"仍未解决。
AI.method: 提出 SPACE-CLIPv2：冻结主干深度解码器，在 CLIP token 空间聚合固定局部邻域。在选定的解码器阶段采样固定 token 模板（token stencil），预测聚合权重，并经门控残差更新注入响应；另设 token 空间高通分支以保留浅层局部对比度。
AI.result: NYU Depth V2 上优于匹配的 SPACE-CLIP 基线；五种子实验一致支持固定采样优于可学习偏移采样；零样本 iBims-1 评估在边界与平面几何指标上进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 受限的局部 token 聚合是从冻结 CLIP 表征解码几何的一种实用机制。

title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. Specialist information improved the LLM by 12.8 points (95% interval 9.7 to 15.9), yet the integrated output stayed 5.9 points below the specialist (95% interval -12.0 to -0.7). A two-source selector oracle reached 92.76%, indicating complementarity that the integrated output did not fully realize. The integrated output missed 140 of 295 specialist corrections (47.5%) but lost 15 of 99 initially correct LLM judgments (15.2%). The deficit remained under prompt and specialist sensitivity analyses. Among CWRU cases solved under both evidence presentations, task-aligned physical evidence yielded lower estimates of susceptibility to incorrect advice in six of seven models (five intervals excluding zero); higher reasoning effort gave no reliable reduction in five models, and a separate four-model TEP analysis gave no clear evidence that it resolves the integration problem. Source quality and integration quality should be evaluated separately: an integration layer should be compared with its stronger standalone component, not only with the unaided LLM.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM作为专业诊断工具集成层的可靠性：在五个诊断数据集上，外部冲突信息会推翻LLM原有的正确判断，且隐式LLM-专家集成未优于更强的独立专家组件。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益被用作专业工具之上的集成层，但更强的组件不必然带来更强的组合系统。作者因此质疑LLM作为集成层的实际价值，旨在区分"源质量"与"集成质量"。
AI.method: 在五个诊断数据集（轴承振动、过程监控、半导体设备）上测试LLM能否可靠使用外部诊断信息；通过配对重复调用将"建议效应"与"输出不稳定性"分离；进行直接集成对比；在TEP确认集上比较无辅助LLM、隐式LLM-专家集成与独立专家；使用双源选择器oracle；开展提示与专家敏感性分析、CWRU物理证据对齐分析及更高推理投入实验。
AI.result: 五个数据集中冲突外部信息均推翻了LLM原有正确判断；四个可直接对比的数据集中，隐式集成均无一致优势。TEP确认集：无辅助64.67%，隐式集成77.43%，专家单独83.33%；专家信息使LLM提升12.8点（95%区间9.7–15.9），但集成输出仍低于专家5.9点（95%区间-12.0至-0.7）。双源oracle达92.76%。集成输出漏掉295个专家修正中的140个（47.5%），并丢失99个原有正确判断中的15个（15.2%）。CWRU中任务对齐物理证据在7个模型中的6个降低了对错误建议的易感性（5个区间不含零）；更高推理投入在5个模型中无可靠改善，四模型TEP分析亦无明确证据。
AI.conclusion: 源质量与集成质量应分别评估；集成层应与更强的独立组件比较，而非仅与无辅助LLM比较。LLM作为集成层存在系统性缺陷，现有提示与推理投入手段未能可靠解决。

title: Mask-Guided KV Cache Eviction in Block Diffusion Language Models
summary: Block diffusion language models keep a large key-value (KV) cache throughout generation and attend to it at every denoising step, limiting both memory capacity and generation speed. Reducing these costs requires deciding which past tokens to use for denoising the current block (selection) and which to keep in memory for future blocks (eviction). We propose MaskAhead, a training-free method that solves both tasks with a single mask-query-based ranking mechanism. Current-block masks guide selection, while probes of upcoming masked blocks guide eviction. Both rank KV entries by their estimated contribution to the attention output. Our quantized variant, Q-MaskAhead, computes selection and attention directly from low-bit KV, largely preserving the selected entries. Experiments on Fast-dLLM-v2, DreamReasoner, and LLaDA2.0-mini cover long-generation reasoning, long-prompt question answering, and needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. On long-prompt QA, MaskAhead reduces KV memory by $9.5\times$ on average with a 1.2-point mean F1 loss relative to dense inference. Q-MaskAhead increases the reduction to $20.1\times$ with a 2.3-point mean F1 loss. In a batch-32 systems profile, MaskAhead achieves $1.23\times$ end-to-end and $1.68\times$ decode-stage speedups over dense inference.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法 MaskAhead，用单一掩码查询排序机制同时完成 KV 选择与淘汰，显著降低块扩散语言模型的内存与解码开销。
AI.motivation: 块扩散语言模型在生成过程中需维持大规模 KV 缓存并在每步去噪时全量关注，导致内存容量与生成速度受限，因此需要决定当前块去噪应使用哪些历史 token（选择）、以及哪些 token 需为未来块保留（淘汰）。
AI.method: MaskAhead 为免训练方法：当前块掩码引导选择，即将到来的掩码块探针引导淘汰，二者共用同一掩码查询排序机制，按 KV 条目对注意力输出的估计贡献排序。量化变体 Q-MaskAhead 直接基于低位 KV 完成选择与注意力计算，并基本保持所选条目不变。
AI.result: 在 Fast-dLLM-v2、DreamReasoner、LLaDA2.0-mini 上覆盖长生成推理、长提示问答与大海捞针检索任务。长提示问答中，MaskAhead 相对稠密推理平均降低 KV 内存 9.5×，平均 F1 损失 1.2 点；Q-MaskAhead 将内存降低提升至 20.1×，平均 F1 损失 2.3 点。batch-32 系统测试中，MaskAhead 相对稠密推理实现 1.23× 端到端与 1.68× 解码阶段加速。
AI.conclusion: MaskAhead 通过统一的掩码查询排序机制统一 KV 选择与淘汰，在保持较小精度损失的同时大幅压缩 KV 内存并提升生成速度，量化版本进一步放大内存收益。

title: Code2Games: Enabling Coding Agents for Gaming World Generation
summary: Generating a high-quality gaming world from a natural-language game intent requires joint reasoning about scene structure, spatial layout, gameplay objectives, interactive entities, and executable gameplay logic. Existing coding agents can generate individual assets, scenes, or scripts, but often struggle to maintain consistency across these components. We propose Code2Games, an agentic framework that builds a structured gaming world upon a base Blender world generated from the same game intent. Code2Games coordinates scene analysis, gameplay planning, constrained gaming-world generation, and gaming-engine customization through a shared scene-gameplay representation with persistent element correspondence. After world generation, Code2Games adapts the generated world to Unreal Engine 5 and employs an execution-guided reconstruction process that uses compilation diagnostics, runtime feedback, and gameplay test results to resolve inconsistencies arising during engine adaptation. To systematically evaluate gaming-world generation, we introduce the GameCode4D benchmark, which comprises ten fixed game prompts spanning different levels of scene and gameplay complexity. We evaluate the generated results across four dimensions: visual quality, interactive fidelity, multimodal artifact quality, and playable-game quality. Experiments demonstrate that, compared with direct gaming-world generation by coding agents and existing baseline methods, Code2Games consistently improves the visual quality and interactive fidelity of generated gaming worlds, as well as the quality of the resulting games after engine adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出Code2Games智能体框架，从自然语言游戏意图出发，在Blender基础世界上构建结构化游戏世界，并适配至UE5，配合GameCode4D基准进行四维评估。
AI.motivation: 从自然语言游戏意图生成高质量游戏世界需要联合推理场景结构、空间布局、玩法目标、交互实体与可执行游戏逻辑。现有编码智能体虽能生成单个资产、场景或脚本，但难以维持各组件间的一致性。
AI.method: Code2Games以同一游戏意图生成的Blender基础世界为起点，通过共享的场景-玩法表示与持续的元素对应关系，协调场景分析、玩法规划、受约束的游戏世界生成与游戏引擎定制；生成后适配至Unreal Engine 5，并采用执行引导的重建流程，利用编译诊断、运行时反馈和玩法测试结果消解引擎适配中的不一致。
AI.result: 引入GameCode4D基准，包含十个固定游戏提示，覆盖不同场景与玩法复杂度；从视觉质量、交互保真度、多模态产物质量、可玩游戏质量四个维度评估。实验表明，相较编码智能体直接生成游戏世界及现有基线方法，Code2Games在视觉质量、交互保真度以及引擎适配后的游戏质量上均持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 共享表示与执行引导的适配机制能有效提升自然语言驱动的游戏世界生成的一致性与可玩性，GameCode4D为系统化评估提供了基准。

title: Causal Improvement Graph for Agentic Harness Optimization
summary: Agentic Harness is the runtime that constructs task context and controls execution flow, thereby shaping overall agent performance. Given a fixed model and external evaluation, automated Harness optimization seeks to improve this runtime through an iterative proposal--evaluation loop to better solve target tasks. Existing meta-harness methods mainly adopt proposer-centric discovery, in which an LLM-based proposer integrates accumulated experimental findings to determine subsequent Harness revisions. This places the burden of maintaining the evolving improvement state on the proposer as history expands and its underlying experimental logic becomes harder to discern. In this paper, we introduce the Causal Improvement Graph (CIG), a graph-governed meta-harness framework that externalizes the evolving improvement state in a persistent graph, allowing prior findings to directly govern subsequent Harness optimization through local proposer operations. CIG grows and links Evidence, Hypothesis, Intervention, and Outcome nodes to represent what was observed, how it may be explained, how to test that explanation, and what the evaluation reveals. Their structural relations preserve how the improvement state changes across iterations, allowing local proposers to build directly on relations among prior findings rather than recover them from raw history. Across various agent tasks, CIG discovers stronger Harnesses than previous meta-harness baselines and remains robust to the choice of task solver and proposer. Structural ablations further support the design of an explicit improvement state with graph-governed evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果改进图（CIG），一种以图结构治理的元Harness框架，通过持久化图显式记录改进状态，使先前的实验发现能直接指导后续Harness优化，从而在多种任务上超越既有元Harness基线。
AI.motivation: 现有元Harness方法采用以提议者为中心的发现范式，需由LLM提议者整合累积实验发现来决定后续Harness修改。随着历史膨胀、实验逻辑愈发难以辨识，维护演进中的改进状态的负担全部落在提议者身上，成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: CIG将演进中的改进状态外化为持久化图，并链接Evidence、Hypothesis、Intervention、Outcome四类节点，分别表示"观察到的现象""可能的解释""验证该解释的手段"以及"评估揭示的结果"。节点间的结构关系保留改进状态随迭代的变化，局部提议者可基于既有发现的关系直接构建，而非从原始历史中重新挖掘。
AI.result: 在多种agent任务上，CIG发现的Harness优于此前的元Harness基线，且对任务求解器和提议者的选择均保持鲁棒性；结构性消融实验进一步验证了显式改进状态与图治理演进设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将演进中的改进状态外化为图结构并由图治理其演进，可有效缓解以提议者为中心范式的状态维护负担，为自动化Harness优化提供了一种可扩展、鲁棒的新范式。

title: Communication Shapes Collective Inference in Self-Adapting LLM Societies: Evidence from Mafia
summary: When does communication help a group identify hidden adversaries, and how does its value change as the group adapts? In Mafia, an informed minority hides inside an uninformed majority whose only evidence is open play. The zero-information game, where each day's vote eliminates a random player, is exactly solved and scores every society; matched-casting comparisons between protocols identify the effect of communication. Societies of 8-100 claude-haiku-4-5 agents (7,416 analyzed games, 1.9M model calls) adapt by rewriting and inheriting private strategy notes. Simultaneous broadcast improves adversary identification over silence in all nine compositions tested (8-46 players). Turn-taking removes most of this advantage; its voting landslides are as frequent as broadcast's but land on mafia near chance (1.08x versus 2.53x). At 70 players, agents reading eight statements per day identify adversaries worse than silent ones, and limited talk is worth less than at 46 players. Adaptation is fast but need not help. In their first broadcast games, citizens announce their role far more often than mafia (91% vs. 30%) and first-day votes find mafia at three times chance; within two generations citizens stop announcing and the cue fades, a change the inherited notes carry. In controlled redeployments at 16 players, societies carrying sixty generations of their own notes score below societies with none. Communication shapes both collective inference and the signals it depends on, so a protocol's value must be measured together with the adaptation that changes those signals.

AI.tldr: 本文以"零信息"随机投票基线精确求解为标尺，用7,416局、190万次模型调用的8–100人Mafia实验，量化沟通对识别隐藏对手的价值，并揭示该价值会随群体策略适应（继承私人笔记）而衰减甚至反转。
AI.motivation: 沟通何时帮助群体识别隐藏的少数派（mafia），其价值如何随群体适应而变化，此前缺乏可精确对照的基线，也未考虑沟通所依赖的信号本身会被适应改变，因此需要既有精确评分标尺、又能匹配阵容做协议对比的实验框架。
AI.method: 以零信息博弈（每日随机淘汰）作为精确可解的评分基线，对8–100人的claude-haiku-4-5智能体社会进行匹配阵容对照实验，比较同时广播、轮流发言与沉默三种协议；社会通过改写并继承私人策略笔记进行多代适应（共7,416局、190万次模型调用）。
AI.result: 同时广播在全部九种阵容（8–46人）中相对沉默提升了对手识别；轮流发言消解了大部分优势，其投票压倒性程度与广播相当，但命中mafia仅为随机水平的1.08倍，而广播为2.53倍。70人时每日读八条发言的agent识别表现反而差于沉默者，有限发言的价值低于46人。适应很快但不必然有益：首局广播中平民宣布身份远多于mafia（91% vs 30%），首日投票命中mafia达随机三倍；两代内平民停止宣布、该线索消失，并由继承笔记延续。16人的对照重新部署中，携带六十代自身笔记的社会得分低于无笔记社会。
AI.conclusion: 沟通同时塑造集体推理及其所依赖的信号，因此协议的价值必须在与适应共变的条件下共同测量；适应虽快，却可能削弱甚至逆转沟通的优势。

title: AraYoungVoices: A Diverse L1/L2 Corpus of Arabic Child and Adolescent Speech
summary: State-of-the-art ASR systems primarily target native adult speech, leading to substantial performance gaps for children, adolescents, and L2 speakers. We introduce AraYoungVoices, a 151.72-hour Arabic read-speech corpus from 286 speakers aged 7--18, comprising AraKids (7--12) and AraTeens (13--18). The corpus includes 146 native Arabic (L1) and 140 second-language (L2) speakers, with native speakers spanning Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, and North African dialectal backgrounds and L2 speakers representing diverse linguistic backgrounds across the Americas, Asia, Africa, and Europe. We benchmark four pretrained ASR models under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings using unseen-speaker-$\&$-unseen-prompt (USUP) and unseen-speaker-$\&$-seen-prompt (USSP) evaluations. Results show that L2 speech remains substantially more challenging than L1 speech, with the largest errors observed mainly for younger L2 speakers. Age-specific fine-tuning improves the matched age group, while joint fine-tuning provides a stronger balance across populations. ASR hypotheses are also consistently closer to the standard reading prompt than to the verbatim transcription, particularly for L2 speech, suggesting partial normalization of reading deviations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AraYoungVoices，一个 151.72 小时、286 名 7--18 岁说话人的阿拉伯语朗读语音语料库，并系统评测四个预训练 ASR 模型在零样本与微调条件下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有先进 ASR 系统主要面向母语成年人语音，对儿童、青少年及第二语言（L2）说话人存在显著性能差距；阿拉伯语青少年语音资源尤其稀缺。
AI.method: 构建 AraYoungVoices 语料库，含 AraKids（7--12 岁）与 AraTeens（13--18 岁），覆盖 146 名 L1 与 140 名 L2 说话人，L1 涵盖埃及、海湾、黎凡特和北非方言，L2 来自美洲、亚洲、非洲和欧洲多种语言背景；在零样本与微调设置下，采用未见说话人-未见提示（USUP）与未见说话人-已见提示（USSP）两种评测协议，对四个预训练 ASR 模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: L2 语音难度显著高于 L1 语音，最大错误主要出现在年龄较小的 L2 说话人；按年龄分组微调可改善对应年龄组表现，联合微调则在各人群间取得更好的平衡；ASR 假设与标准朗读提示的一致性持续高于与逐字转写的一致性，L2 语音尤为明显，表明存在对朗读偏差的部分归一化。
AI.conclusion: AraYoungVoices 填补了阿拉伯语青少年及 L2 语音资源空白；实验揭示 L1/L2 与年龄维度的性能差异，说明年龄定制与联合微调各具优势，并提示 ASR 输出倾向于向标准朗读文本归一化。

title: CoDG-Net: Structure-Guided Style Diffusion and Collaborative Learning to Mitigate Catastrophic Forgetting in Medical Image Domain Generalization
comment: Proceedings of the Thirty-Fifth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence Main Track. Pages 1622-1630. https://doi.org/10.24963/ijcai.2026/181
summary: Domain Generalization (DG) for medical image segmentation is both highly challenging and critically important. However, existing medical DG methods largely overlook the issue of Catastrophic Forgetting (CF): \textbf{Models often sacrifice their ability to retain source-domain knowledge while pursuing cross-domain robustness.} This can directly threaten diagnostic safety in already-deployed clinical scenarios. To address this, we investigate data augmentation strategies and catastrophic forgetting for medical image DG segmentation. First, we propose a structure-guided style diffusion augmentation method. Constrained by anatomical structure consistency in the frequency domain, this method performs cross-domain diffusion on the amplitude spectrum, generating samples with more diverse and broader style coverage to better support domain generalization. Then, we design a collaborative learning network with a dual-branch interactive architecture (CoDG-Net), together with a novel learning bias-guided strategy that adaptively regulates knowledge transfer at both the layer level and the task level, thereby effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting on the source domain. Experiments and ablation studies on single-source and multi-source medical DG benchmark datasets demonstrate that CoDG-Net not only outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in target-domain segmentation performance, but also achieves a lower forgetting rate on the source-domain data. The code is available at: https://github.com/wangprocess/CoDG-Net.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构引导风格扩散增强与双分支协作学习网络CoDG-Net，在提升医学图像域泛化分割性能的同时缓解源域灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割域泛化方法大多忽视灾难性遗忘问题，即模型在追求跨域鲁棒性时牺牲对源域知识的保留能力，这在已部署的临床场景中会直接威胁诊断安全性。
AI.method: 首先提出结构引导的风格扩散增强方法，在频域中受解剖结构一致性约束，对振幅谱进行跨域扩散，生成风格覆盖更广、更多样的样本以支撑域泛化；随后设计双分支交互架构的协作学习网络CoDG-Net，并引入学习偏置引导策略，在层级别与任务级别自适应调节知识迁移。
AI.result: 在单源与多源医学域泛化基准数据集上的实验与消融研究表明，CoDG-Net在目标域分割性能上优于现有最先进方法，同时在源域数据上取得更低的遗忘率。代码发布于 https://github.com/wangprocess/CoDG-Net。
AI.conclusion: 结构引导扩散增强与偏置引导协作学习可在提升医学图像分割域泛化能力的同时有效缓解源域灾难性遗忘，兼顾跨域鲁棒性与源域知识保留。

title: Salvation Lies Within: Eliciting Inherent Style Transfer in Step-Distilled Diffusion Models
summary: Adapting step-distilled text-to-image (T2I) models through post-training incurs additional computational costs and affects native few-step generation behavior. This motivates a complementary route beyond style-specific adaptation: drawing on the visual knowledge already encoded in step-distilled T2I models to elicit stylistic capabilities through language. Pursuing this direction requires textual guidance that captures how visual attributes jointly define a style and remain applicable as the depicted content changes. To explore this approach, we introduce StyleForge, a fully automatic, training-free framework that expresses reference styles as reusable rendering instructions. By integrating overall rendering characteristics with local color and lighting behavior, StyleForge organizes visual evidence from reference images into a coherent specification of how the target style should be expressed. The specification is then compiled into textual guidance that can be reused across content prompts, enabling frozen step-distilled T2I models to render different subjects and scenes in the reference style while retaining native few-step generation. Extensive experiments show relative gains of up to 29.47\% in generation quality scores over the strongest baseline, while Pareto analysis indicates that improved stylization is accompanied by strong adherence to the requested content. Code is available at https://github.com/sunshy-1/StyleForge.

AI.tldr: 提出 StyleForge：一个全自动、免训练框架，将参考风格表达为可复用的"渲染指令"，通过语言引导冻结的步数蒸馏 T2I 模型实现风格化，同时保留原生少步生成能力。
AI.motivation: 对步数蒸馏 T2I 模型进行后训练式风格适配会带来额外计算开销，并破坏其原生少步生成特性；因此需要一条不依赖风格特定微调的互补路径，即利用模型已编码的视觉知识，通过语言来激发风格化能力。
AI.method: 关键前提是获得能刻画视觉属性如何共同定义风格、且在内容变化时仍适用的文本引导。StyleForge 将参考图像中的视觉证据组织为对目标风格表达方式的连贯规范：融合整体渲染特征与局部颜色、光照行为，再将该规范编译为可跨内容提示复用的文本引导，从而驱动冻结的步数蒸馏 T2I 模型。
AI.result: 大量实验显示，生成质量分数相对最强基线最高提升 29.47%；Pareto 分析表明风格化提升的同时对请求内容的遵循度依然较强。
AI.conclusion: 以语言为媒介、免训练地激发步数蒸馏 T2I 模型的风格能力是可行且有效的，可在不牺牲少步生成与内容保真度的前提下显著提升风格化质量。代码已开源。

title: Usage-Modulated Sentiment Representations in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (main conference). 18 pages, 3 figures, including appendices
summary: Prior work suggests that sentiment can often be captured by approximately linear directions in LLM activation spaces, but a single direction may not fully capture sentiment representations. In natural communication, sentiment is shaped not only by polarity but also by usage factors, such as tone and audience adaptation. We test whether these factors systematically modulate sentiment representations beyond a shared sentiment direction. We construct a controlled paired dataset that holds event content fixed while varying sentiment polarity and usage factors, and analyze Llama, Mistral, and Gemma. We identify a shared sentiment direction, remove it, and test the residual structure through erasure and generation-time tone steering. Across models, the shared direction is robust (median cosine 0.953-0.975), yet removing it leaves 0.833-0.909 of the original positive-negative representation-difference norm. The residuals contain compact, reproducible usage-conditioned structure. Targeted erasure weakens held-out usage metrics more than random and label-shuffled controls. On Llama, outputs steered along residualized tone components are preferred in 92.8% of blind target-tone comparisons while preserving the requested sentiment polarity in 98.7% of evaluated outputs.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验LLM激活空间中的情感表征是否仅为单一线性方向，发现共享情感方向虽稳健，但去除后仍留存大量残差结构，其中包含可复现、受使用因素（语气与受众适应）调节的紧凑结构，可用于擦除与生成时的语气引导。
AI.motivation: 先前研究认为情感可由LLM激活空间中近似线性的方向捕获，但单一方向可能不足以完整刻画情感表征。自然交流中情感不仅由极性决定，还受语气、受众适应等使用因素影响，作者希望验证这些因素是否系统性地调节情感表征。
AI.method: 构建受控配对数据集：固定事件内容，变化情感极性与使用因素；分析Llama、Mistral、Gemma三个模型；识别共享情感方向并将其去除，再通过擦除实验与生成时的语气引导检验残差结构；设置随机与标签打乱对照。
AI.result: 共享情感方向跨模型稳健（中位余弦0.953-0.975）；去除后仍保留0.833-0.909的原始正负表征差范数；残差含紧凑可复现的使用条件结构；定向擦除对留出使用指标的削弱强于随机和打乱标签对照；Llama上沿残差化语气成分引导的输出在盲测目标语气比较中92.8%被偏好，同时98.7%的评估输出保持所要求的情感极性。
AI.conclusion: 情感表征并非单一线性方向，而是由共享情感方向与受使用因素调节的残差子空间共同构成；残差结构具有可解释性与可操控性，可用于细粒度情感与语气控制。

title: Self-Generated Feedback Destabilizes Test-Time Training: A Causal Decomposition of Long-Horizon Adaptation
summary: Test-time training (TTT) lets a model store information in its weights during inference. When the model learns from its own output, however, each update also changes the model that generates the next training example. Across 128K-token streams, retaining generated-text updates worsens prediction on independent human-written text with three TTT-E2E model configurations (labeled 125M, 760M, and 3B). The same failure occurs when Adam updates Qwen3-4B's existing weights. The same update mechanisms can improve on real text, so writing itself is not the failure. Three matched comparisons trace the causal pathway. Fixed Generation removes over 98% of the damage at 125M and 760M by using a frozen model to generate training chunks. Recorded Replay separates the loss caused by reading degraded text from the additional loss stored by updating on it. A paired one-update comparison then shows the local conflict: an update predicts its source better but new real text worse. This cost grows after Closed Loop adaptation, with a few trajectories accounting for most large failures. Finally, Settlement evaluates the candidate state on independent real text before commitment. It leaves mean endpoint gaps of 0.07 and -0.02 nats at 125M and 760M while retaining real-text adaptation. These results motivate checking prediction on independent evidence before retaining an update.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示测试时训练（TTT）在模型从自身生成文本中学习时会损害对独立人类文本的预测能力，并通过三项匹配实验定位因果路径，提出"结算"（Settlement）机制在提交更新前用独立真实文本评估候选状态。
AI.motivation: TTT允许模型在推理时将信息存入权重，但当模型从自身输出中学习时，每次更新都会改变生成下一个训练样本的模型。作者希望探究这种自生成文本更新是否会损害模型在独立人类文本上的预测，并弄清其因果机制。
AI.method: 在128K token流上，用三种TTT-E2E配置（125M、760M、3B）及Adam更新Qwen3-4B进行验证；设计三项匹配对照：(1) Fixed Generation用冻结模型生成训练块；(2) Recorded Replay分离"读取退化文本"与"更新存储"造成的损失；(3) 配对单次更新比较；(4) Closed Loop适应；(5) Settlement在提交更新前用独立真实文本评估候选状态。
AI.result: 保留生成文本更新会恶化对独立人类文本的预测。Fixed Generation在125M和760M上消除超过98%的损害；配对单次更新显示局部冲突——更新能更好预测其源文本但对新真实文本预测更差；Closed Loop适应后该代价增大，少数轨迹贡献了大部分严重失败；Settlement在125M和760M留下0.07和-0.02 nats的平均端点差距，同时保留真实文本适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 自生成文本更新会导致模型偏离真实数据分布而损害泛化。在保留更新前，应先用独立证据检验预测效果，即Settlement机制可作为有效的防护手段。

title: CGDD-Net: Context-Guided Dynamic Detail Modeling for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
summary: Accurate retinal vessel segmentation requires features that capture vascular geometry while preserving information for fine-scale reconstruction. We propose CGDD-Net, a context-guided dynamic detail modeling network that connects adaptive feature extraction to a shared decoder pathway. Context-Guided Scale-Adaptive Deformable Encoding (CSDE) combines fixed-grid convolution with deformable local attention to capture vascular patterns at multiple spatial extents. Spatially Adaptive Multi-Kernel Gating (SAMG) selects receptive-field responses at each location. Dynamic Cross-Scale Detail Fusion (DCDF) aligns the gated intermediate features and compresses them into an eight-channel representation, which is reused at three decoder resolutions together with selected encoder skips. This design consolidates intermediate information before decoding instead of transferring each middle-stage feature through a separate direct skip. On DRIVE, CHASE\_DB1, STARE, and HRF, CGDD-Net achieves AUC values of 0.9824, 0.9938, 0.9895, and 0.9874, with F1 scores of 0.8323, 0.8102, 0.8510, and 0.8157, respectively. The complete model contains 1.96 million trainable parameters. In cumulative ablations, the full model improves F1 over the internal baseline by 2.48, 0.61, and 3.49 percentage points on DRIVE, CHASE\_DB1, and STARE. Twelve directed cross-dataset experiments further characterize transfer without target-domain adaptation. The results support shared intermediate detail delivery as an effective, parameter-compact architecture for retinal vessel segmentation. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/lixincheng-xcl/CGDD-Net}.

AI.tldr: 提出CGDD-Net视网膜血管分割网络，通过上下文引导的动态细节建模与共享解码路径，在四个数据集上取得高精度且参数量仅1.96M。
AI.motivation: 准确分割视网膜血管需兼顾血管几何特征与细尺度重建信息；传统编码器-解码器逐级直接跳连传递中间特征，冗余且难以整合多尺度细节。
AI.method: CSDE将固定网格卷积与可变形局部注意力结合，捕获多空间尺度的血管模式；SAMG在每个位置选择感受野响应；DCDF对齐门控中间特征并压缩为八通道表示，在三个解码分辨率复用并结合选定的编码器跳连；即在解码前整合中间信息，而非逐级单独跳连。
AI.result: DRIVE、CHASE_DB1、STARE、HRF上AUC分别为0.9824、0.9938、0.9895、0.9874，F1为0.8323、0.8102、0.8510、0.8157；完整模型1.96M可训练参数；累积消融中F1较内部基线分别提升2.48、0.61、3.49个百分点；并完成12组有向跨数据集实验评估无目标域适应的迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: 共享中间细节传递是一种有效且参数紧凑的视网膜血管分割架构。

title: Towards cross-cultural study of folksong lyrics with machine translation
summary: Music is universally present in human societies. Ethnomusicologists have long been documenting the diverse expressions of human musicality, and comparative musicology has recently brought several studies of folksong to a more global scale. Such cross-cultural research has not been conducted on lyrics: the language barrier has so far prevented work with multi-lingual data. However, Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies have reached a stage where this language barrier may no longer be prohibitive. Combining folksong lyrics corpora across five languages, we machine-translate them to a pivot language with a pre-trained neural topic model, and we examine the relationship between content and social function within each language, and across languages for wedding songs. As expected, human evaluation of translation results shows that non-Indo-European languages suffer from overall worse translation quality. Experiments with topic models then indicate that the content of lyrics is at best partially related to the social function of folksongs across all languages. These experiments are just first steps into cross-cultural folk musics lyrics analysis; however, they do indicate that a previously unobserved web of cross-cultural relationships beyond ethnomusicological typologies may be uncovered through the study of what people sing across the world's diverse folk musics.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次对跨语言民歌歌词进行大规模计算分析：将五种语言的民歌歌词语料机器翻译至中枢语言，用预训练神经主题模型考察歌词内容与社会功能的关系，发现歌词内容与民歌社会功能至多部分相关，并提示跨文化音乐关系存在未被既有音乐学类型学捕捉的潜在网络。
AI.motivation: 民歌研究长期受语言障碍限制，跨文化比较多停留在旋律与音乐学类型学层面，歌词内容因多语种数据处理困难而鲜有系统研究。作者希望借助已趋成熟的自然语言处理技术突破这一壁垒，将跨文化民歌比较从"如何唱"扩展到"唱什么"。
AI.method: 整合五种语言的民歌歌词语料，使用预训练神经网络翻译模型将其统一翻译为中枢语言；对翻译结果进行人工质量评估，并在此基础上运用预训练神经主题模型，分别在单一语言内部及跨语言（以婚礼歌曲为对象）层面分析歌词内容与社会功能之间的关联。
AI.result: 人工评估显示，非印欧语系语言的翻译质量整体明显差于印欧语系语言；主题模型实验表明，在所有语言中，歌词内容与民歌社会功能之间最多只是部分相关，而非强对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是从计算视角切入跨文化民歌歌词分析的初步尝试，尽管仍受翻译质量等因素制约，但已显示出一条超越传统民族音乐学类型学的、先前未被观察到的跨文化关联网络，可通过研究世界各地民歌的歌词内容加以揭示。

title: Should We Skip Diffusion?
summary: Diffusion models learn semantic representations while generating images. In the Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (DDT), a condition encoder provides features that guide a velocity decoder in denoising. To enable effective denoising at all noise levels, these features must capture both high-level abstract structures and low-level details. However, skip/residual connections in the encoder allow shallow features to bypass successive transformations, which may limit progressive abstraction, or at least make it difficult to disentangle different levels of abstraction. We propose DDT-RFE, which removes the residual connections around the Self-Attention and MLP operations in each encoder block while maintaining stable training. To retain the information that abstraction discards but that the decoder still needs, we fuse the input patch embedding with intermediate and final encoder features to form the encoder output. The decoder thus has access to information from multiple encoder depths, while each encoder block is able to learn more abstract representations. DDT-RFE achieves overall improvements over DDT across visual understanding tasks, including image classification, semantic segmentation, object discovery, and semantic correspondence, while using fewer encoder blocks. It also achieves a lower FID for image generation on ImageNet.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DDT-RFE，通过移除编码器中自注意力和MLP的残差连接以获得更强的渐进抽象能力，并用多深度特征融合补偿丢失的细节信息。在视觉理解任务与图像生成上均优于 DDT，且编码器块更少。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在生成图像的同时学习语义表示。DDT 中条件编码器为速度解码器提供去噪引导特征，这些特征需在不同噪声水平下同时包含高层抽象结构与低层细节。但编码器中的跳跃/残差连接让浅层特征绕过逐层变换，限制了渐进抽象过程，并使不同抽象层级的特征难以解耦。
AI.method: 提出 DDT-RFE：在每个编码器块中去除自注意力与 MLP 操作周围的残差连接，同时保持训练稳定；为保留抽象过程中被丢弃但解码器仍需要的信息，将输入 patch embedding 与中间层及末端编码器特征进行融合，构成编码器输出，使解码器可访问多个编码深度的信息，而各编码块仍能学习更抽象的表征。
AI.result: 在多项视觉理解任务上（图像分类、语义分割、目标发现、语义对应）相较 DDT 取得整体提升，且使用更少的编码器块；在 ImageNet 图像生成上取得更低的 FID。
AI.conclusion: 去除编码器残差连接并配合多深度特征融合，可在提升编码器抽象能力的同时保留解码所需细节，从而在理解与生成任务上同时获益，并具备更高的参数效率。

title: How Much Do LLM-as-a-Judge Design Choices Matter? A Systematic Comparison of Prompt Designs, Rating Scales, and Models
summary: Researchers increasingly use Large Language Models as judges (LLM-as-a-judge) to evaluate model outputs. Yet there are no standards for how to design these judges. Typically, researchers choose the prompt, rating scale, and model intuitively. If these choices change the judge's verdicts, two studies can reach different conclusions about the same facts. To address this risk and to provide an empirical basis for judge designs, we evaluate 10 reasoning models across multiple designs on two tasks: a scalar rating of sentence sentiment and toxicity (over 500 items per category), as well as a binary accuracy classification of question-answer pairs (n=600). For the rating tasks, despite judges showing significant disagreements with the human ground truth, the practical size of differences is small enough to consider most judges reliable (mean absolute deviation of 0.11 points on a 1 - 7 scale); toxicity judges even outperform standard classifiers. Judges are also highly accurate on average (96.5%) for the accuracy classification task. However, design choices can produce shifts: changing the rating scale alone can shift measured bias by up to 0.93 points (rating task), and while accuracy levels are rarely impacted, design choices consistently impact judge leniency (classification task; leniency drop of 28.9 percentage points when using detailed prompts, and up to 56.1 percentage points when switching models). Counterintuitively, lower reasoning effort affects neither accuracy nor leniency. Across both tasks, model identity is the dominant source of variance. These findings suggest that while LLM judges are broadly trustworthy in aggregate, design choices can be meaningful sources of variance. Given the growing reliance on automated evaluation in LLM research, we intend this study as a methodological reference for designing more robust and replicable LLM-as-a-judge pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了10个推理模型在多种评审设计下的表现，发现LLM评判者整体可信（评分任务MAD 0.11分、分类任务准确率96.5%），但设计选择会产生显著方差（评分量表变化可致偏差偏移0.93分，详细提示可使宽松度下降28.9个百分点），模型身份是最大方差来源。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge被广泛用于评估模型输出，但缺乏评判者设计的标准，研究者凭直觉选择提示、评分量表和模型。若这些选择改变评判结论，两项研究可能对相同事实得出不同结论。为应对该风险并为评判设计提供实证依据，作者开展本研究。
AI.method: 评估10个推理模型，在两项任务上跨多种设计进行测试：(1) 句子情感与毒性的标量评分（每类超500条）；(2) 问答对的二元准确性分类（n=600）。考察提示、评分量表、模型身份与推理努力等设计因素对评判结果的影响。
AI.result: 评分任务中，评判者与人工基准存在显著分歧，但实际差异较小（1-7量表上平均绝对偏差0.11分），多数评判者可靠；毒性评判者甚至优于标准分类器。分类任务平均准确率96.5%。但设计选择会产生偏移：仅改变评分量表即可使测得偏差偏移最多0.93分；分类准确率很少受影响，但设计选择持续影响评判宽松度（使用详细提示时宽松度下降28.9个百分点，切换模型时最多下降56.1个百分点）。反直觉的是，降低推理努力既不影响准确率也不影响宽松度。两项任务中，模型身份均为方差主导来源。
AI.conclusion: LLM评判者总体上可信，但设计选择是显著方差来源。鉴于自动评估在LLM研究中日益重要，本文可作为方法学参考，用于设计更稳健、更可复现的LLM-as-a-judge流程。

title: vMF Sentence LDA: A Spherical Topic Model over Sentence Embeddings
summary: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and models derived from it remain widely used topic models. LDA observes each document as a bag-of-words and models each topic by a categorical distribution over the vocabulary, so that it uses neither the internal structure of the document nor the similarity in meaning between words. Earlier work has responded to this limitation in two ways: many models have introduced embeddings, and some have assigned topics to sentences rather than to words. Their combination, a topic model that observes sentence embeddings, remains little explored. We propose vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA), which keeps the admixture structure of LDA, observes each sentence as its L2-normalized embedding and models each topic by a von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distribution, which matches the cosine geometry of sentence embeddings. Its per-topic parameter count and per-iteration cost are linear in the embedding dimension, versus quadratic for the full-covariance Gaussian distribution in the existing model over sentence embeddings. We evaluate vSLDA where the limitation is expected to matter most, among topics that share much of their vocabulary: the topics that subdivide the one subject of a collection, and the narrow topics that result when a corpus is divided into a large number of topics. On two corpora, vSLDA attains the best mean rank against eight baselines when the fine categories within each coarse category are classified from the document-topic distributions. On the whole corpus, its advantage appears or widens as the number of topics grows. Weighting the word frequencies of each sentence by its topic posterior yields expected topic-word counts of the same form as those of LDA, so that the standard topic coherence and diversity measures apply to models that assign topics to sentences. On their product, topic quality, vSLDA leads in most within-category conditions of both corpora.

AI.tldr: 提出 vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA)，以 L2 归一化句嵌入为观测、以 von Mises-Fisher 分布建模话题，保留 LDA 混合结构，参数与迭代开销随嵌入维度线性增长，在共享词汇量大的细粒度话题上优于八个基线。
AI.motivation: LDA 将文档视为词袋并按词汇表上的类别分布建模话题，既未利用文档内部结构，也未考虑词义相似性。已有工作分别引入嵌入或将话题分配到句子，但"以句嵌入为观测的话题模型"这一结合方向研究不足。作者希望在最能体现该局限的场景——共享大量词汇的细粒度话题——验证句嵌入话题模型的优势。
AI.method: vSLDA 保留 LDA 的混合（admixture）结构，将每个句子视为一个观测，使用其 L2 归一化嵌入，并用 von Mises-Fisher 分布建模每个话题，以匹配句嵌入的余弦几何。相比基于全协方差高斯分布的句嵌入模型，其每话题参数量和每次迭代开销由二次降为随嵌入维度的线性。通过以话题后验对句子词频加权，得到与 LDA 相同形式的话题-词期望计数，从而可沿用标准的话题一致性（coherence）与多样性（diversity）指标。
AI.result: 在两个语料库上，当从文档-话题分布对每个粗类别的细类进行分类时，vSLDA 相对八个基线取得最佳平均排名。在整个语料上，其优势随话题数增加而出现或扩大。在话题质量（一致性与多样性的乘积）上，vSLDA 在两个语料库的多数类内条件下领先。
AI.conclusion: 将句嵌入与 LDA 混合结构结合是可行且有效的：vMF 建模兼顾计算效率与嵌入的余弦几何，在细粒度、词汇重叠大的话题场景下性能更优，并可直接复用 LDA 的话题评价体系。

title: ReMAP: Restoring the Perceptual Cycle with Reasoning-Time Latent Visual Memory
summary: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reason for longer, attention to the initial visual input diminishes, weakening visual grounding. Visual memory reintroduces visual evidence during reasoning. We conduct a controlled analysis of visual memory along three axes: curation, organization, and access. We find that local evidence benefits from global context, compact latent representations balance accuracy and visual-context cost, and the utility of memory access depends on the reasoning state. Guided by these findings, we propose ReMAP (Reasoning-Time Memory-Augmented Perception), which couples two complementary latent memories: a static, question-conditioned Global memory that preserves scene and cross-image context, and a dynamic Local memory that uses this context as an anchor while selecting and re-encoding region-level evidence according to the current reasoning state. Both memories return compact latent tokens inserted into the reasoning sequence, and a reinforcement-learning access policy trained with branched rollouts decides when to continue reasoning or invoke Global or Local memory. On ten benchmark families, ReMAP outperforms prior visual-memory methods on all four multi-image benchmarks, exceeding the strongest prior results on MuirBench and MIMIC by 8.38 and 14.84 percentage points. Across four backbone families, enabling memory access improves over the same trained model with memory disabled, and on shared V*Bench, CV-Bench-2D, and MuirBench questions ReMAP reduces the visual tokens entering the reasoning sequence by 51.0-76.8% relative to the native-resolution backbone. Further analyses show that Global and Local memory form distinct yet complementary latent representations. Together, these components restore the perceptual cycle by letting the reasoning state trigger targeted visual retrieval, with the retrieved evidence guiding subsequent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出ReMAP框架，通过静态全局记忆与动态局部记忆在推理时按需重引入视觉证据，缓解MLLM长推理中视觉接地弱化问题，在多图基准上大幅超越先前方法并显著减少视觉token。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型推理链越长，对初始视觉输入的注意力越低，导致视觉接地能力减弱。视觉记忆可在推理过程中重新引入视觉证据，但记忆的整理、组织与访问方式尚缺乏系统性分析。
AI.method: 先沿curation、organization、access三轴对视觉记忆做控制实验，发现局部证据需全局上下文、紧凑隐表示能平衡精度与视觉上下文开销、记忆访问效用依赖推理状态。据此提出ReMAP：耦合两个互补隐记忆——静态、问题条件的Global记忆保存场景与跨图上下文；动态Local记忆以该上下文为锚，根据当前推理状态选择并重编码区域级证据。两者返回紧凑隐token插入推理序列，并用分支式rollout训练的强化学习访问策略决定继续推理或调用Global/Local记忆。
AI.result: 在十个基准族上，ReMAP在四个多图基准上均优于先前视觉记忆方法，MuirBench与MIMIC分别超出最强先前结果8.38与14.84个百分点；在四个骨干族上，开启记忆访问均优于同一模型禁用记忆；在V*Bench、CV-Bench-2D与MuirBench共享问题上，相对原生分辨率骨干将推理序列视觉token减少51.0-76.8%。
AI.conclusion: Global与Local记忆形成不同却互补的隐表示，共同恢复"推理状态触发定向视觉检索、检索证据引导后续推理"的感知循环，为长推理下的视觉接地提供有效方案。

title: Small Agents with Semantic Search: Efficient Multilingual Code Localization
summary: Locating relevant files from natural-language requests is a core subtask for agents operating over code repositories. We investigate whether this task can be delegated to compact, specialized models to enable on-device search while reducing the token usage, latency, and inference cost of larger agents. We show that semantic search improves file localization, with gains in accuracy, cross-language transfer, and inference efficiency. To study this setting, we introduce a training framework for file-localization agents built around ColGREP, a local semantic search tool based on late-interaction retrieval models. Our recipe combines weighted supervised fine-tuning on teacher trajectories, assigning turn-level credit based on retrieval outcomes, with reinforcement learning on localization quality. We train three model families with fewer than two billion parameters to formulate search queries, inspect retrieved content, and identify relevant files. On localization tasks derived from SWE-bench Lite and Multi-SWE-bench Flash, ColGREP-equipped agents substantially improve over their base models and outperform corresponding GREP-based agents. In addition to improving localization accuracy, ColGREP reduces mean end-to-end trajectory latency by 44.1\% on CPU while using 29.1\% fewer tokens, and enables better generalization to programming languages unseen during fine-tuning. These results suggest that compact, tool-specialized localization agents can provide an efficient interface between natural-language requests and large codebases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于ColGREP的语义检索文件定位代理训练框架，用小参数模型实现高效代码库文件定位。
AI.motivation: 自然语言请求到代码库相关文件的定位是代码仓库代理的核心子任务。作者希望将该任务委托给紧凑的专用模型，以支持端上搜索，同时降低大代理的token消耗、延迟与推理成本。
AI.method: 构建围绕ColGREP的训练框架，ColGREP是基于late-interaction检索模型的本地语义搜索工具。训练配方结合了教师轨迹上的加权监督微调（按检索结果分配回合级信用）与面向定位质量的强化学习。训练了三个参数量少于20亿的模型族，用于构造搜索查询、检查检索内容并识别相关文件。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Lite和Multi-SWE-bench Flash衍生的定位任务上，配备ColGREP的代理显著优于其基座模型，并超过对应的GREP-based代理。相比GREP，ColGREP在CPU上将平均端到端轨迹延迟降低44.1%，token使用减少29.1%，且对微调期间未见过的编程语言具有更好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的、工具专用的定位代理可作为自然语言请求与大型代码库之间的高效接口。

title: SearchJev: A Fast and Calibrated System-1 Model for Search Agents
summary: Search agents repeatedly make short decisions about relevance, evidence sufficiency, and search actions. Using generative language models for these decisions introduces latency and unreliable confidence. We present SearchJev, a fast and calibrated System-1 model that separates search decisions from System-2 reasoning and generation. Given a search state and a decision schema, SearchJev directly scores legal options without autoregressive output generation. We propose Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions (SLCD) to learn decision probabilities from uncertain supervision and calibrate their confidence. In a dual-system search agent, SearchJev handles short decisions and delegates uncertain judgments to System 2, which retains planning, query generation, and answer composition. We also introduce SearchDecision-Bench, a benchmark unifying six types of search decisions for training and evaluation. On SearchDecision-Bench, SEARCHJEV improves decision quality over same-size Qwen3.5 autoregressive models, achieves 5.2-5.3 times faster decisions, and reduces average expected calibration error by 41-74%. On BrowseComp-Plus, the dual-system agents achieve a 3.7-4.7 times speedup in active search time while improving answer accuracy from 45% to up to 54%.

AI.tldr: SearchJev是一种快速且校准良好的System-1模型，将搜索决策与System-2推理生成分离，通过SLCD软标签学习实现校准决策，在多类搜索决策上提升质量、加速5倍以上并显著降低校准误差。
AI.motivation: 搜索智能体需反复对相关性、证据充分性、搜索动作等做短决策，使用生成式语言模型进行这些决策会带来高延迟和不可靠的置信度。
AI.method: 提出SearchJev，直接对合法选项打分而无须自回归生成；并提出Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions（SLCD）从不确定监督中学习决策概率并校准置信度；在双系统智能体中，SearchJev处理短决策，将不确定判断交给System 2负责规划、查询生成与答案组织；同时构建SearchDecision-Bench统一六类搜索决策用于训练与评估。
AI.result: 在SearchDecision-Bench上，SearchJev相较同规模Qwen3.5自回归模型提升决策质量，决策速度提升5.2-5.3倍，平均期望校准误差降低41-74%；在BrowseComp-Plus上，双系统智能体主动搜索时间加速3.7-4.7倍，答案准确率从45%提升至最高54%。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索短决策交由快速校准的System-1模型处理，并将不确定判断委派给System-2，可在提升搜索效率的同时改善决策质量与答案准确率。

title: LoopMoEVR: Loop-Based Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Unified UHD Video Restoration
summary: Recently, unified high-definition image restoration has attracted considerable attention; however, existing models tend to excessively increase their depth in pursuit of improved generalization, which often yields only limited gains. Meanwhile, loop-based learning paradigms have drawn widespread attention due to their low parameter counts and strong regression capability, as exemplified by GPT-6 and looped Transformers. In this paper, we introduce the loop learning paradigm to address restoration tasks that require cross-domain learning. Specifically, we propose LoopMoEVR, a loop-based mixture-of-experts model capable of handling degraded ultra-high-definition (UHD) inputs. First, a degradation-conditioned low-rank loop embedding is designed to construct input-dependent stage conditions. Second, a spatio-temporal iterative adaptive normalization module, termed IterAda3DN, is developed to fuse local features with global loop context, thereby performing position-wise affine modulation. Finally, the expert branches further integrate the attention-updated local and global video states with the loop conditions to generate dedicated modulation parameters, while an input-conditioned depth predictor adaptively configures the number of loop iterations. With only approximately 0.884M trainable parameters, the proposed model uniformly handles UHD video dehazing, deraining, denoising, and low-light enhancement tasks, achieving state-of-the-art restoration performance on both public benchmarks and real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LoopMoEVR，一种循环式混合专家模型，用于统一处理超高分辨率视频去雾、去雨、去噪与低光增强，仅约 0.884M 可训练参数即达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有统一高清图像复原模型为提升泛化性往往不断加深网络深度，但收益有限；同时循环学习范式（如 looped Transformers）以低参数量、强回归能力受到关注。作者希望将循环学习引入需要跨域学习的复原任务中。
AI.method: 提出 LoopMoEVR：1）退化条件低秩循环嵌入，构建输入相关的阶段条件；2）时空迭代自适应归一化模块 IterAda3DN，融合局部特征与全局循环上下文，实现逐位置仿射调制；3）专家分支将注意力更新的局部与全局视频状态同循环条件结合，生成专用调制参数；4）输入条件深度预测器自适应配置循环迭代次数。
AI.result: 在约 0.884M 可训练参数下，统一处理 UHD 视频去雾、去雨、去噪与低光增强，在公开基准与真实场景中均取得 SOTA 复原性能。
AI.conclusion: 将循环学习与混合专家结合可有效替代单纯加深网络，在极低参数预算下实现跨域统一的 UHD 视频复原。

title: InstMoE: Adaptive Multimodal Routing with Specialized Experts
summary: Multimodal inputs are inherently heterogeneous, not only across modalities but also in the information pathways required for effective prediction. To address this limitation, we propose InstMoE, an adaptive expert routing framework for multimodal learning. InstMoE dynamically routes each input to specialized unimodal and cross-modal experts, allowing the model to adapt its information pathways to the characteristics of the input. However, routing can be misled when modality-specific variations obscure task-relevant semantics. Such irrelevant variations may distort routing decisions, causing inputs to be assigned to inappropriate experts. We therefore introduce a Contrastive Semantic Alignment module, which encourages semantically similar inputs to share task-relevant representations while suppressing irrelevant modality-specific variations. Experiments on multimodal sentiment analysis benchmarks demonstrate that InstMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance on CMU-MOSEI and CH-SIMS v2 while using substantially fewer parameters than competitive baselines. Further analysis shows that different inputs exhibit distinct expert preferences, demonstrating that InstMoE moves beyond fixed fusion toward adaptive multimodal computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InstMoE，一种面向多模态学习的自适应专家路由框架，通过将输入动态路由到单模态与跨模态专家，并引入对比语义对齐模块抑制模态特有噪声干扰，在多模态情感分析基准上以更少参数取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态输入具有内在异质性，不仅体现在模态之间，还体现在有效预测所需的信息通路上。现有方法多采用固定融合策略，难以根据输入特性自适应调整信息通路；同时，模态特有变化会掩盖任务相关语义，导致路由决策被误导，将输入分配给不合适的专家。
AI.method: 提出InstMoE自适应专家路由框架，为每个输入动态路由至专门的单模态专家和跨模态专家，使模型的信息通路随输入特征自适应调整。同时引入对比语义对齐（Contrastive Semantic Alignment）模块，促使语义相似的输入共享任务相关表示，并抑制无关的模态特有变化，从而纠正被误导的路由决策。
AI.result: 在多模态情感分析基准上，InstMoE在CMU-MOSEI和CH-SIMS v2数据集上达到SOTA性能，且相比竞争基线使用显著更少的参数。进一步分析表明，不同输入表现出不同的专家偏好。
AI.conclusion: InstMoE突破了固定融合范式，实现了自适应的多模态计算，在保证高性能的同时显著降低参数量，验证了自适应专家路由与语义对齐相结合的有效性。

title: Belief-Trajectory Energy: Measuring the Path to a Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) progressively revise their predictions across Transformer layers, yet we typically observe only the final output, discarding the trajectory through which it is formed. We introduce Belief-Trajectory Energy(BTE), a model-grounded measure that characterizes an input through the layerwise predictive revisions it induces in a model. By mapping intermediate states into a shared predictive space, BTE provides a principled measure of belief change that can be summarized as either a scalar or a structured depth profile. Theoretically, we show that local BTE corresponds to predictive revision under the Fisher-Rao geometry, while the sequence of revisions captures information beyond the initial-to-final belief change. Empirically, scalar BTE provides a model-relative signal of difficulty across diverse reasoning tasks, while richer BTE representations support human-LLM review detection and fine-grained generator attribution, reaching up to $0.998$ macro-AUROC and $95.6\%$ eight-way attribution accuracy. Further analysis shows that BTE develops throughout pretraining and is selectively reshaped by targeted training, demonstrating that the resulting measurement reflects what the scoring model has learned. Together, our results establish belief trajectories as a principled model-grounded signal and suggest a broader perspective in which learned models can themselves serve as instruments for characterizing the data they process. More demonstrations can be found at https://yingjiahao14.github.io/BTE-web/.

AI.tldr: 提出Belief-Trajectory Energy (BTE)，将LLM逐层预测修正的轨迹映射到共享预测空间，作为模型根基的信号，用于难度度量、人机审核检测与生成器归因。
AI.motivation: LLM在Transformer各层中逐步修正预测，但通常只保留最终输出，丢弃了信念形成的轨迹信息，缺乏刻画这一过程的原理化度量。
AI.method: 把中间层状态映射到共享预测空间，构造逐层预测修正序列；理论证明局部BTE对应Fisher-Rao几何下的预测修正，且修正序列蕴含超越首末信念差的信息；可汇总为标量或结构化深度剖面。
AI.result: 标量BTE在多类推理任务上提供模型相对的难度信号；结构化BTE表示支持人机审核检测与细粒度生成器归因，最高达0.998 macro-AUROC与95.6%八分类归因准确率；BTE随预训练发展并被定向训练选择性重塑。
AI.conclusion: 信念轨迹是一种原理化的模型根基信号，表明学习到的模型本身可作为刻画其所处理数据的工具。

title: PCLM: Small-target localization with frozen CLIP via prototype contrast and local magnification
summary: Small targets occupy few patches in a vision-language encoder, so spatial features often mix object appearance with surrounding content. We propose Prototype Contrast and Local Magnification (PCLM), a support-conditioned localization method that uses a frozen CLIP encoder. Five masked support images per class define foreground and background prototypes through equally weighted regional features. Their difference provides a shared scoring direction for query patches, explicitly comparing target evidence with the demonstrated background. Nine overlapping query windows are enlarged and encoded independently to sample small targets more densely. Reprojection and coverage averaging combine their scores into a continuous localization map. The class direction occupies 2 KiB regardless of support count and transfers unchanged across datasets with mapped categories. On 5,047 small-target queries from VOC, COCO, ADE20K and Oxford-IIIT Pets, PCLM achieves higher mean pixel AP than every evaluated text-conditioned localization baseline on each dataset under our evaluation protocol. Gains over the strongest scene-dataset baselines range from 5.63 to 13.23 percentage points. At comparable measured latency, local magnification improves scene small-target AP by 4.51 to 5.68 points over whole-canvas enlargement. Factorial experiments show that prototype contrast increases the benefit of local observation, including under matched image-coordinate filtering. Support-budget experiments show that additional examples refine category estimation without increasing representation size or query-time scoring cost.

AI.tldr: 提出PCLM（原型对比与局部放大）小目标定位方法，基于冻结CLIP编码器，通过掩码支持图像构建前景/背景原型并做对比评分，配合九窗口局部放大采样，在四个数据集上超越所有文本条件定位基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言编码器中，小目标占据的patch极少，导致空间特征常将目标外观与周围背景内容混合，难以精确定位小目标。
AI.method: 1) 支持条件式定位，使用冻结CLIP编码器；2) 每类5张掩码支持图像，通过等权区域特征定义前景与背景原型，其差值为查询patch提供共享评分方向，显式对比目标证据与示范背景；3) 九个重叠查询窗口独立放大编码，更密集采样小目标；4) 通过重投影与覆盖率平均将各窗口得分融合为连续定位图。
AI.result: 在VOC、COCO、ADE20K、Oxford-IIIT Pets的5,047条小目标查询上，PCLM在各数据集的平均像素AP均高于所有评测的文本条件定位基线，较最强场景数据集基线提升5.63至13.23个百分点；在相当实测延迟下，局部放大较整幅放大提升小目标AP达4.51至5.68点；因子实验表明原型对比增强了局部观测收益；支持预算实验显示增加示例可细化类别估计而不增大表示规模或查询时评分开销。
AI.conclusion: PCLM以极小的类方向表示（2 KiB，与支持数无关）实现跨数据集迁移，验证了原型对比与局部放大相结合在小目标定位上的有效性。

title: Selecting Repetition Counts Across Model Scales in Data-Constrained Pretraining
summary: The repetition count that works best for a small language model may not remain best at a larger scale. We study this effect in pretraining with a finite target corpus mixed with generic data at a fixed target fraction. On Wikipedia-derived data and Proof-Pile-2, the ranking of measured repetition counts changes with model size, and a 520M Proof-Pile-2 experiment confirms that reducing repetition from sixteen to eight improves loss while using fewer training tokens. We use loss curves from several smaller models to retain a short list of promising repetition counts for evaluation at a larger scale. On PubMed and Caselaw, candidate sets fixed before target-model training retain the lowest-loss measured count on the original evaluation grids at both 200M and 520M. This supports candidate retention as a practical alternative to exact point prediction. We also relate the pruning regression to an empirical scaling model with two opposing repetition-dependent loss terms. A first-order expansion in log model size yields the linear form used by the selection rule, providing a scaling-based interpretation of the candidate-selection procedure.

AI.tldr: 研究重复次数最优值随模型规模变化的效应，提出"候选保留"策略：用小模型loss曲线筛选有前景的重复次数，在大模型上评估，无需精确点预测，并以双损失项的缩放模型解释该过程。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型上最优的数据重复次数不一定在大规模模型上仍最优。已有方法依赖对小模型结果的精确点预测来决定大模型的重复次数，但这一预测并不稳健，需要一种更实用的替代方案。
AI.method: 在固定目标语料比例下，将有限目标语料与通用数据混合进行预训练；使用Wikipedia衍生数据、Proof-Pile-2、PubMed、Caselaw等数据集；用多个小模型的loss曲线保留一小组有前景的重复次数候选集，再在200M和520M规模模型上评估；并将剪枝回归关联到含两个相反重复依赖损失项的实证缩放模型，通过对log模型规模的一阶展开得到选择规则所用的线性形式。
AI.result: 在Wikipedia衍生数据和Proof-Pile-2上，实测重复次数的排名随模型规模变化；520M的Proof-Pile-2实验证实将重复次数从16降到8可改善loss且使用更少训练token；在PubMed和Caselaw上，训练目标模型前固定好的候选集在200M和520M规模下均保留了原始评估网格上loss最低的实测重复次数。
AI.conclusion: 候选保留（candidate retention）是精确点预测的实用替代方案；剪枝回归可由含两个相反重复依赖损失项的缩放模型解释，一阶展开给出的线性形式为候选选择过程提供了基于缩放的合理解释。

title: Representation--Behavior Alignment for Explainable Weakly-Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) provide a natural way to make video anomaly detection more explainable. However, their final decisions do not always fully use the discriminative information contained in their hidden states, an issue we refer to as representation--behavior misalignment. We decompose this gap into a capacity component that measures discriminative information never aggregated into the readout position, and a directional component that measures the angular mismatch between the optimal and the native normal--abnormal axis at that position. Across multiple video anomaly detection benchmarks and MLLM backbones the directional component dominates, and residual-stream tracing shows that native-axis separability rises sharply in several mid-to-late attention layers. Because both components are governed by attention rather than MLP updates, we propose Representation--Behavior Alignment (RBA), a parameter-efficient method that adapts those layers using video-level labels alone while updating about 0.012\% of the backbone parameters. Experiments on three benchmarks show that RBA improves native-readout performance and better aligns the model's decision direction with discriminative representations, and it produces anomaly decisions and explanations through a single generative process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出表征—行为对齐（RBA）方法，通过以视频级标签适配MLLM中后期注意力层，修复隐藏状态判别信息与最终决策方向的错位，仅更新约0.012%参数即提升视频异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）虽能使视频异常检测更具可解释性，但其最终决策并未充分利用隐藏状态中的判别信息，存在"表征—行为错位"。作者将其分解为容量成分与方向成分，发现方向成分占主导，且原生轴可分性在中后期注意力层显著上升，据此提出改进动机。
AI.method: 提出表征—行为对齐（RBA），一种参数高效方法：仅使用视频级标签，适配若干中后期注意力层（因两成分均由注意力而非MLP更新主导），仅更新约0.012%的骨干参数。
AI.result: 在多个视频异常检测基准与多种MLLM骨干上，方向成分占主导；残差流追踪显示原生轴可分性在中后期若干注意力层急剧上升；在三个基准上，RBA提升了原生读出性能，使决策方向与判别表征更对齐。
AI.conclusion: RBA通过单一生成过程同时产出异常判定与解释，验证了以极低参数开销对齐表征与行为的有效性。

title: RoMod: Temporal Routing Modulation via Mixture-of-Experts for Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Intermediate-layer features from multimodal large language models have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection (VAD), yet the origin of their discriminative power remains unclear. We study this question using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, whose explicit expert structure and sparse activation make their internal computation easier to inspect. With a fully frozen backbone and no additional training, we find that anomaly-related evidence is concentrated in a small set of experts. These experts recur across layers, spontaneously specialize in different anomaly types, and together form a dynamic routing subnetwork. We further show that the output channels most strongly influenced by these experts are also the hidden dimensions that contain the most anomaly-relevant information. Routing statistics can therefore serve as an internal anomaly cue that complements semantic features.Based on these findings, we propose RoMod, an efficient VAD framework trained with only \(5\%\) of weakly labeled videos. RoMod includes a Routing-Modulated Fusion module, RoMF, and a Routing-aware Temporal Network, RoTN. RoMF uses routing signals to adaptively recalibrate hidden semantic channels. Its design also prevents the routing branch from bypassing semantic features and making predictions on its own. RoTN captures the temporal evolution of anomalies from onset to persistence and termination. Experiments on three benchmarks show that RoMod achieves state-of-the-art performance while running substantially faster than dense backbones of comparable size.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多模态大模型中稀疏MoE模型中间层特征的判别力来源，发现异常证据集中于少数可复现、专门化的专家，并构成动态路由子网络；据此提出仅用5%弱标注视频训练的RoMod框架，在三个基准上达到SOTA且速度显著优于同规模稠密骨干。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型的中间层特征在视频异常检测（VAD）中表现强劲，但其判别力来源尚不明确，缺乏可解释的机制理解，限制了特征的进一步利用与模型设计。
AI.method: 以稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型为研究对象，利用其显式专家结构与稀疏激活便于内部计算观察的特性，在完全冻结骨干且不额外训练的条件下分析专家与异常的关系；据此提出RoMod框架，包含Routing-Modulated Fusion（RoMF）模块与Routing-aware Temporal Network（RoTN）：RoMF用路由信号自适应重校准隐藏语义通道，并防止路由分支绕过语义特征单独预测；RoTN建模异常从出现、持续到终止的时间演化。
AI.result: 异常相关证据集中于少量专家，这些专家跨层复现、自发专精于不同异常类型，共同形成动态路由子网络；受这些专家影响最强的输出通道也正是含最多异常相关信息的隐藏维度；路由统计可作为补充语义特征的内部异常线索。RoMod在三个基准上取得SOTA性能，且运行速度显著快于同规模稠密骨干。
AI.conclusion: 路由统计可作为可解释的内部异常线索，与语义特征互补；基于该发现设计的RoMod在仅5%弱标注数据下实现高效、领先的VAD性能，为利用MoE内部结构进行异常检测提供了新思路。

title: How Does Geometry Enter Generated Motion?
comment: 43 pages, 13 figures, including supplementary material. Project page: https://liweihan1107.github.io/samelaw/
summary: Under a fixed physical law, the visible geometry of a scene determines how motion must change. We ask how video generators realize this relationship. We fix the law and the initial state and change only the geometry drawn in the first frame, within matched families of tracks and deflectors, and compare each generated trajectory with the simulator prediction for that geometry. Paired interventions change one thing at a time: a local bump, the height of a barrier, the words of the prompt, the length of the clip. Across nine image-to-video models, geometry is preserved and shapes the motion: the speed of the ball follows the drawn undulation of a track. A physical state would carry this response forward, and here the generated motion parts from the law. The mean slope barely accelerates the ball, successive contacts fail to compose through a consistent state, an edit ahead of the ball alters its motion before it arrives, and the ball climbs over barriers higher than its release point. Two global conditions organize the global trajectory: text strongly controls the destination, while clip length strongly controls timing in the open-weight models tested. The pattern persists with photographed first frames. Current video generation thus behaves as geometry-conditioned motion synthesis whose evolution of state differs systematically from that of a fixed physical law.

AI.tldr: 论文通过成对干预实验（只改变首帧几何、提示词或视频长度）系统考察了九个图生视频模型是否遵循固定物理定律，发现模型能由几何决定运动方向与速度，但状态演化与物理模拟器的预测系统性偏离，表现为几何条件化的运动合成而非物理状态推演。
AI.motivation: 在固定物理定律下，场景的可见几何必然约束运动应如何变化。作者希望回答：视频生成模型是否真正掌握了这一关系，即其生成的运动是遵循物理定律的状态演化，还是仅依据几何做出表面合理的运动合成。为此需要严格控制变量，把"定律"和"初始状态"固定，只改变首帧中绘制的几何。
AI.method: 采用受控的成对干预（paired interventions）范式：固定物理定律与初始状态，仅在匹配的轨道与偏转器（tracks and deflectors）族内改变首帧绘制的几何。每次干预只改变一个因素，包括局部凸起、屏障高度、提示词措辞、视频片段长度。将每个生成轨迹与该几何对应的物理模拟器预测进行逐一对比，在九个图生视频模型上重复，并用真实拍摄的首帧进行验证。
AI.result: 几何信息被保留并塑造运动：小球速度随绘制轨道的起伏而变化。然而，本应延续物理状态的信息在此断裂——平均坡度几乎不使小球加速；连续接触不能通过一致的状态进行合成；位于小球前方、尚未到达处的编辑会提前改变其运动；小球还能爬上高于释放点的屏障。两个全局条件组织整体轨迹：文本强烈控制终点/目的地，片段长度强烈控制开权重模型中的时序。该模式在真实拍摄的首帧上同样存在。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频生成的行为应被理解为"几何条件化的运动合成"，其状态演化与固定物理定律下的状态演化存在系统性差异。这表明模型并未内化一致的物理状态，而是以几何为条件生成视觉上合理的运动。

title: SemCam: Semantic Camera Motion Control for Video Generation
summary: Controlling the camera relative to a moving subject in an existing video is challenging: behaviors such as maintaining a frontal view require the camera to adapt to the subject's changing position and orientation, making the desired trajectory difficult to specify in advance. Existing camera-controlled video-to-video methods typically rely on explicit trajectories or reference motions, which do not directly express these dynamic camera--subject relationships. We introduce semantic camera motion control, a novel video-to-video task in which a reference video and a target motion label specify the desired subject-relative camera behavior without an explicit target trajectory. Our method, SemCam, learns to realize this behavior while preserving source content. It combines shared-basis low-rank adaptation with motion-conditioned modulation, while a background-consistency loss encourages fidelity in regions visible in both reference and target videos. We construct 661 paired videos covering eight semantic camera behaviors and evaluate on a separate 109-scene benchmark using subject-relative motion metrics, appearance measures, and a user study. SemCam achieves a semantic-motion success rate of 68.6%, compared with 45.3% for Vista4D, the strongest evaluated baseline, while maintaining comparable subject identity preservation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"语义相机运动控制"这一新的视频到视频任务，并设计了SemCam方法，在无需显式目标轨迹的情况下，实现主体相对相机行为，语义运动成功率达68.6%。
AI.motivation: 在已有视频中控制相机相对于运动主体的关系具有挑战性，诸如保持正面视角等行为需要相机适应主体不断变化的位置与朝向，使得目标轨迹难以预先指定。现有相机控制的视频到视频方法通常依赖显式轨迹或参考运动，无法直接表达这些动态的相机—主体关系。
AI.method: SemCam结合共享基低秩适配（shared-basis low-rank adaptation）与运动条件调制，并引入背景一致性损失，以提升在参考视频与目标视频中均可见区域的保真度，从而在保留源内容的同时实现所期望的相机行为。研究构建了661对视频覆盖八种语义相机行为，并在独立的109场景基准上进行评估，采用主体相对运动指标、外观度量以及用户研究。
AI.result: SemCam的语义运动成功率为68.6%，而最强基线Vista4D为45.3%，同时保持了相当的主体身份保持能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出并验证了语义相机运动控制这一新任务的可行性，表明通过参考视频与目标运动标签即可有效表达相机—主体动态关系，SemCam在成功率和身份保持方面优于现有基线。

title: Construction and Evaluation of Machine Learning Models for Near-Real-Time Fire Detection from MTG FCI Imagery
summary: Geostationary satellite observations are important for wildfire detection and monitoring. The current study evaluates machine learning models for MTG FCI near-real-time fire detection in 1- and 2-km spatial configurations and compares them with threshold-based algorithms. The models were trained and evaluated using VIIRS fire reference data across diverse ecological regions in Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. The key results are that 1-km models significantly outperform both their 2-km variants and operational threshold products. The constructed 1-km models achieved F1 scores higher by up to 0.36 compared to baseline products. Importantly, the 1-km models detected small fires with higher probability compared to competing models. Finally, the models robustly detected fires up to 260 min earlier than baseline products. To support opensource applications, our trained models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了用于MTG FCI近实时火点检测的机器学习模型（1 km与2 km空间配置），并与阈值算法对比；1 km模型显著优于2 km版本及业务化阈值产品。
AI.motivation: 地球静止卫星观测对野火检测与监测至关重要，需评估机器学习方法在MTG FCI近实时火点检测中的性能，并与传统阈值算法进行比较。
AI.method: 以VIIRS火点参考数据为标签，在欧洲、非洲和中东的多种生态区域训练并评估1 km与2 km空间配置的机器学习模型。
AI.result: 1 km模型显著优于2 km变体及业务化阈值产品；F1分数最高提升0.36；对小火点的检测概率更高；可较基线产品提前最多260分钟稳健检测到火点。
AI.conclusion: 1 km机器学习模型在MTG FCI近实时火点检测中表现优异，且训练模型已公开以支持开源应用。

title: Verification Trap: Understanding Test-Time Selection Failures under False Premises in Code Generation
summary: Test-time compute has become a central way to improve code generation: systems sample multiple candidate programs and use verifier-visible evidence to select the final output. This paradigm implicitly assumes that the verifier provides a corrective signal independent from the generator. We challenge this assumption under misleading task premises. When the generator and verifier share a false premise, they become coupled through a mistaken belief: the generator produces premise-consistent shortcuts, while the verifier supplies evidence that fails to expose them. Consequently, the selector may choose a hidden-test-wrong candidate even when a hidden-test-correct program exists in the pool. We call this failure mode Verification Trap. Across three code-generation benchmarks and five code models, false premises consistently degrade first-sample correctness, reduce selector-chosen correctness after 64-sample test-time selection, and amplify recoverable mis-selection. Mechanistically, verifier-written tests inherit the premise-level blind spot, reshaping verifier-visible candidate space away from hidden-test correctness. These traces make Verification Trap predictable before hidden execution: a lightweight gold-free predictor using verifier-visible features reaches 0.846 AUROC. Our results identify decoupled evidence as a key mitigation axis: coupled scaling provides limited recovery, whereas premise-agnostic robustness auditors recover substantial oracle headroom.

AI.tldr: 在误导性题目前提下，生成器与验证器会因共享错误信念而耦合，形成"验证陷阱"，使测试时选择即使存在正确候选也可能选错；该陷阱可被免标注预测器识别。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算范式（多采样+验证器选择）隐含假设验证器提供独立于生成器的纠错信号。作者质疑该假设在题目前提有误时是否成立，并探究生成器与验证器共享错误前提时选择机制如何失效。
AI.method: 在三个代码生成基准和五个代码模型上，引入错误题目前提，观察首样本正确率、64样本测试时选择后选中正确率及可恢复误选的变化；分析验证器所写测试是否继承前提层面的盲区；构建仅用验证器可见特征的轻量级、无需黄金答案的预测器来预警该陷阱。
AI.result: 错误前提一致地降低首样本正确率，在64样本测试时选择后降低选中正确率，并放大可恢复的误选。机制上，验证器编写的测试继承了前提层级的盲区，使验证器可见的候选空间偏离隐藏测试正确性。该陷阱在隐藏执行前可预测，轻量预测器AUROC达0.846。耦合式扩展恢复有限，而前提无关的鲁棒性审计器能恢复大量oracle余量。
AI.conclusion: 验证器与生成器的解耦证据是关键的缓解维度；提高样本量收效有限，应引入与题目前提无关的鲁棒性审计来恢复被掩盖的正确候选。

title: TIRMamba: A Thermal-Prior-Modulated State-Space Network for Sub-Million-Parameter Infrared Image Super-Resolution
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing. Code and trained models will be released at https://github.com/julian135707/TIRMamba upon acceptance
summary: Infrared image super-resolution is currently led by Mamba-based networks with 26 to 37 million parameters, which are difficult to deploy on the airborne and handheld platforms where thermal imaging is most needed. This paper presents TIRMamba, a network with 896K to 910K parameters for single-channel thermal imagery. A Thermal Prior Highway computes gradient, local-contrast and spectral cues once at the input and, through one adapter per residual group, modulates a weight-tied bidirectional state-space trunk and gates its dual-scale detail branch; a tri-path reconstruction adds the learned residual to a bicubic radiometric baseline. Because the standard benchmark provides only 265 infrared training images and evaluates fusion products on full images, we train with a replay strategy: grayscale DIV2K pre-training followed by fine-tuning on 64-pixel patches drawn with equal probability from the infrared and natural corpora. At scale factor 4, TIRMamba matches the strongest protocol-trained methods on both official test sets with 29 to 40 times fewer parameters and 2.8 to 9.4 times lower latency; at scale factor 2 it gives the highest SSIM on both. A variant with prior-conditioned selectivity, TIRMamba-Rad, corrects a 3 dB raw-thermal failure of an intermediate size-invariant design and gives the best results at scale factor 4 on raw-thermal, unmanned-aerial-vehicle and independent-sensor test sets. Code and trained models will be released at https://github.com/julian135707/TIRMamba upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出超轻量红外图像超分网络 TIRMamba（896K–910K 参数），通过热先验高速公路、权重共享双向状态空间主干与三路径重建，在多个基准上以极少参数与低延迟匹配或超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 Mamba 的红外图像超分网络参数量高达 2600 万至 3700 万，难以部署在机载与手持等最需要热成像的平台上，因此需要极轻量且有效的单通道热成像超分方案。
AI.method: 提出 TIRMamba：1）热先验高速公路在输入端一次性计算梯度、局部对比度与光谱线索，并通过每个残差组一个适配器调制权重共享的双向状态空间主干，同时门控双尺度细节分支；2）三路径重建将学习残差叠加到双三次辐射基线；3）训练采用回放策略——先在灰度 DIV2K 预训练，再用从红外与自然语料等概率抽取的 64 像素块微调。另提出带先验条件选择性的变体 TIRMamba-Rad。
AI.result: 4 倍放大下，TIRMamba 在官方测试集上匹配最强协议训练方法，参数量减少 29–40 倍，延迟降低 2.8–9.4 倍；2 倍放大下在两个测试集上取得最高 SSIM。TIRMamba-Rad 修正了某中间尺寸不变设计在原始热成像上的 3 dB 失败，并在原始热成像、无人机与独立传感器测试集的 4 倍放大上取得最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: TIRMamba 以极小参数量实现与主流 Mamba 超分网络相当或更优的性能，验证了热先验与轻量状态空间结构在机载、手持热成像场景的部署可行性，代码与模型将在接收后开源。

title: Recurrent Latent Visual Search for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding is a critical capability for GUI agents powered by vision-language models, helping them execute user instructions by locating the corresponding elements in screenshots. Single-step grounding struggles with small elements and dense layouts, motivating multi-step visual search. However, existing approaches commonly rely on textual reasoning misaligned with visual space or costly multi-round interactions with external visual tools. To make multi-step visual search an explicit spatial process within the model, we propose ReLaViS, which performs Recurrent Latent Visual Search in a single interaction round. At each step, a spatial search head uses the hidden state to query the screenshot's visual tokens, producing a spatial search distribution that explicitly represents the search focus. This distribution then aggregates the visual tokens into latent visual evidence, which is recurrently fed back as the next input embedding to condition subsequent search. We further introduce a GUI-aware coarse-to-fine inductive bias through trajectories constructed from flat element annotations, supervising search from the global interface through intermediate element groups to the target. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, ReLaViS improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy by 3.1 percentage points to 56.3% with only a 3.5% increase in inference FLOPs and outperforms the matched single-step baseline on all five benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReLaViS，将多步视觉搜索显式建模为模型内部的循环潜在空间过程，在单轮交互中完成GUI定位，以低成本显著提升精度。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding对视觉语言模型驱动的GUI代理至关重要，但单步定位在小元素和密集布局上表现不佳，需要多步视觉搜索。现有方法要么依赖与视觉空间错位的文本推理，要么依赖与外部视觉工具的高成本多轮交互。
AI.method: 提出ReLaViS，在单轮交互内进行循环潜在视觉搜索。每步由空间搜索头用隐藏状态查询截图的视觉token，生成显式表示搜索焦点的空间搜索分布；该分布聚合视觉token为潜在视觉证据，并循环反馈作为下一步输入嵌入以条件化后续搜索。此外，通过由扁平元素标注构建的轨迹引入GUI感知的由粗到细归纳偏置，监督从全局界面到中间元素组再到目标的搜索。
AI.result: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B，ReLaViS将ScreenSpot-Pro准确率提升3.1个百分点至56.3%，推理FLOPs仅增加3.5%，并在全部五个基准上优于匹配的单步基线。
AI.conclusion: ReLaViS将多步视觉搜索内化为显式空间过程，在低计算开销下有效提升GUI grounding性能，验证了循环潜在视觉搜索与由粗到细监督的有效性。

title: FORGE: Verification-Gated Behavioral Repair for Generative Language Models
summary: Generative large language models (LLMs) inherit undesirable behaviors from pre-training, including demographic bias and toxic generation, that often emerge only after deployment and affect a small subset of inputs. A repair should eliminate the identified defect, preserve the model's overall functionality and, ideally, provide correctness guarantees. Existing approaches address this only partially: gradient-based fine-tuning lacks per-instance guarantees and becomes unstable with few defect samples; model editing assumes explicit knowledge replacement rather than behavioral correction; and constraint-based repair is largely restricted to discriminative models with unique target outputs. We present FORGE, a framework for targeted behavioral repair of generative language models that separates defect localization, weight editing, and behavioral verification into independent stages. Its core is a repair abstraction that converts localized defective generation into explicit optimization objectives, enabling verification-oriented repair techniques to operate on autoregressive generation. FORGE is editing-mechanism agnostic: we instantiate it with (1) a constraint-based quadratic optimization method that provides per-sample repair certificates and (2) a null-space projection editor that minimizes interference with the original model distribution, both under the same localization and verification protocol. On five open-source LLMs, FORGE consistently achieves larger reductions in bias and toxicity than gradient-based fine-tuning with minor perplexity degradation. The two backends exhibit complementary performance across architectures, which a lightweight causal probe traces to where toxicity-related signals concentrate. FORGE also remains effective with only a handful of defective examples, where conventional fine-tuning often oscillates or fails to converge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FORGE 框架，将生成式语言模型的定向行为修复解耦为缺陷定位、权重编辑与行为验证三阶段，通过将缺陷生成转化为显式优化目标，兼容约束型二次优化（提供逐样本修复证书）与零空间投影编辑两种后端，在五个开源 LLM 上实现优于梯度微调的偏见与毒性降低，且困惑度损失较小。
AI.motivation: 生成式 LLM 从预训练中继承了人口统计学偏见与毒性生成等不良行为，这些问题往往在部署后才暴露，且仅影响小部分输入。理想的修复需同时满足三点：消除已识别缺陷、保持模型整体功能、并（最好）提供正确性保证。现有方法只能部分满足：梯度微调缺乏逐实例保证且在缺陷样本稀少时不稳定；模型编辑假设的是显式知识替换而非行为纠正；约束型修复多局限于具有唯一目标输出的判别式模型。
AI.method: FORGE 将定向行为修复拆分为缺陷定位、权重编辑与行为验证三个独立阶段。核心是一种修复抽象，把定位到的缺陷生成转换为显式优化目标，使面向验证的修复技术能够作用于自回归生成。该框架对编辑机制不敏感，实例化了两种后端：(1) 基于约束的二次优化方法，提供逐样本修复证书；(2) 零空间投影编辑器，最小化对原始模型分布的干扰。两者共用同一套定位与验证协议。
AI.result: 在五个开源 LLM 上，FORGE 在偏见与毒性降低方面持续优于梯度微调，且困惑度退化较小。两种后端在不同架构上表现互补，轻量级因果探针将其归因于毒性相关信号的集中位置。在仅有少量缺陷样本时 FORGE 仍有效，而传统微调往往振荡或无法收敛。
AI.conclusion: 将缺陷定位、权重编辑与行为验证解耦，并借助修复抽象把生成缺陷转为显式优化目标，可让约束型与零空间类修复技术适用于自回归生成模型，从而在保持整体功能的前提下实现带保证、样本高效的行为修复，且不同编辑后端具有架构互补性。

title: Order Matters: Competition-Guided Query Ordering for RNN-Based Object Detection
summary: DETR-style detectors use one-to-one bipartite matching during training to assign object queries to ground-truth objects, enabling end-to-end set prediction without non-maximum suppression (NMS). However, without an explicit de-duplication procedure, multiple queries can still produce highly similar hypotheses for the same object, making training unstable and predictions less decisive. Inspired by the sequential ordering of NMS, we propose DETRNN, a plug-and-play module that turns unordered object queries into a competition-aware sequence for recurrent refinement. DETRNN builds an explicit confidence-and-similarity based order from prior predictions, then refines queries with an RNN along this order to model competition inside the decoder. This ordered recurrent refinement reduces redundant predictions, stabilizes optimization, and improves final detection accuracy. Experiments on multiple DETR-style detectors show consistent gains with comparable efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出DETRNN即插即用模块，将无序object queries转为基于置信度与相似度的竞争感知序列，并用RNN按序递归精炼以抑制冗余预测、稳定训练、提升检测精度。
AI.motivation: DETR类检测器用一对一二分匹配实现端到端集合预测、免NMS，但缺乏显式去重机制，多个query仍可能对同一目标生成高度相似假设，导致训练不稳定、预测不够果断。
AI.method: 受NMS顺序排序启发，DETRNN先将无序object queries依据先验预测构建显式的置信度-相似度排序，形成竞争感知序列；再沿该顺序用RNN对queries递归精炼，从而在解码器内部建模query间的竞争关系。
AI.result: 在多种DETR类检测器上取得一致的性能增益，且效率相当。
AI.conclusion: 有序递归精炼可减少冗余预测、稳定优化并提升最终检测精度，DETRNN可作为即插即用模块广泛适用于DETR风格检测器。

title: Long-MDR: Long-Context Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Deep-Research Agents
comment: Investigating whether the report number in Figure 9 is correct and that may be a bug that affect the analysis
summary: The next generation of multimodal research agents must reason over long-lived research histories rather than short model completions. During a single task, an agent may repeatedly search the web, inspect visual evidence, revisit earlier hypotheses, and accumulate tens of thousands of tokens of multimodal context. Despite this trend, online RL for multimodal research agents remains largely confined to shorter contexts and interaction horizons. We push online RL training to 128k context and 75+ tool-interaction turns. To our knowledge, this is the first online multimodal deep-research RL study trained at 128k context, and the first trained with a 75 tool-turn horizon. Scaling to this regime exposes several practical limitations of conventional RL training. Early in training, weak policies make poor use of large interaction budgets, causing expensive rollouts with little reward improvement. Later, policy entropy can collapse before performance has saturated, prematurely ending useful learning. We introduce Long-MDR, a three-component training recipe designed specifically for this setting: On-Policy Distillation Warmup, Progressive Horizon Expansion, and Entropy-Triggered Rescue. Together, these techniques improve both the learning efficiency and stability of long-horizon RL, enabling continued gains in a regime where direct training is slow and costly. At a 50-turn evaluation budget, our RL-trained Long-MDR-9B ranks first on five of six benchmarks among the compared 7B-9B agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多模态深度研究智能体的长时程在线强化学习（128k上下文、75+工具交互轮），提出三组件训练配方Long-MDR以提升训练效率与稳定性，其9B模型在6个基准中的5个上领先同规模智能体。
AI.motivation: 下一代多模态研究智能体需在长时程研究历史（反复检索、查看视觉证据、回溯假设、累积数万token多模态上下文）上进行推理，但现有多模态智能体的在线RL仍局限于较短上下文与交互时程。扩展到长上下文/长交互时程后暴露出两类问题：(1) 训练早期弱策略无法有效利用大额交互预算，导致昂贵rollout却收益甚微；(2) 后期策略熵在性能饱和前就塌缩，过早终止有益学习。
AI.method: 提出Long-MDR三组件训练配方：1) On-Policy Distillation Warmup（同策略蒸馏预热）；2) Progressive Horizon Expansion（渐进式时程扩展）；3) Entropy-Triggered Rescue（熵触发救援）。在该配方下将在线RL训练扩展到128k上下文与75+工具交互轮。
AI.result: 在50轮评估预算下，RL训练得到的Long-MDR-9B在所比较的7B-9B智能体中于6个基准中的5个排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是首个在128k上下文训练、且首个采用75工具轮时程的在线多模态深度研究RL研究；三项技术共同提升了长时程RL的学习效率与稳定性，使在直接训练缓慢且昂贵的区间仍能持续获得性能提升。

title: Learning to Curate What You Generate for Generalizable Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) aims to learn novel classes from limited annotations while preserving prior knowledge. Existing methods typically assume a sufficiently large base session, but this assumption fails when both base and incremental data are scarce, leading to weak initial representations, semantic drift, and unstable boundaries. We study this underexplored yet realistic setting, termed Generalizable FSCIL (G-FSCIL), where the base session itself contains only a few classes. Although synthetic data can alleviate supervision scarcity, naively mixing generated samples often introduces semantic noise and exacerbates old-new boundary conflicts. To address this, we propose a framework that curates trustworthy synthetic knowledge for stable G-FSCIL.
