Specifically, we first construct class-specific synthetic candidate pools using a frozen latent diffusion model, where class inversion is performed at the first observation and the resulting condition embeddings are reused for on-demand generation. Building on these candidates, we learn a knowledge curation strategy that selects samples with both semantic consistency and visual diversity, and distill this process into a transferable selection policy during the base session, which is then reused without further optimization. Leveraging the curated synthetic data, we further design a boundary-stable incremental adaptation scheme, including synthetic-informed prototype initialization and bidirectional boundary calibration to mitigate old-new conflicts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing FSCIL baselines, with reduced forgetting and improved balance between old and new classes. Code is available at https://github.com/NiHaoWoJiaoYYC/G-FSCIL.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基类与会话数据均稀缺的通用小样本类增量学习（G-FSCIL），提出通过冻结潜扩散模型构建类特定合成候选池，学习可信知识筛选策略，并进行边界稳定的增量适应，从而缓解语义漂移与新类冲突，性能优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有FSCIL方法假设基类会话样本充足，当基类与会话数据都稀缺时会导致初始表示弱、语义漂移和边界不稳定；直接混合合成数据又会引入语义噪声并加剧新旧类边界冲突。
AI.method: 1）用冻结潜扩散模型构建类特定合成候选池，在首次观测时进行类反转并复用条件嵌入按需生成；2）学习知识筛选策略，选择语义一致且视觉多样的样本，并在基类会话中蒸馏为可迁移选择策略，后续无需优化即可复用；3）设计边界稳定的增量适应方案，包括合成信息引导的原型初始化和双向边界校准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法持续优于现有FSCIL基线，减少遗忘并改善新旧类之间的平衡。代码见 https://github.com/NiHaoWoJiaoYYC/G-FSCIL。
AI.conclusion: 在基类与会话数据均稀缺的G-FSCIL设定下，引入可信合成知识与边界稳定适应机制可有效缓解语义漂移和新旧类冲突，提升增量学习稳定性。

title: F$^2$ SLAM: Turning Feed-Forward Geometry into Persistent Factors for SLAM
summary: Feed-forward 3D models provide strong multi-view geometric priors, while on- line simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) relies mainly on local mea- surements and can accumulate drift over long sequences. Existing attempts to combine the two typically treat feed-forward predictions as an external geomet- ric state that is aligned or fused with the online estimate after the fact, which keeps broader multi-view evidence outside the optimizer that refines the SLAM state. We present F2SLAM, which instead converts feed-forward geometry di- rectly into optimization-native target-weight measurements attached to a persis- tent dense factor graph. A high-frequency stream maintains local tracking con- straints and graph connectivity, while a low-frequency stream uses wider multi- view context to selectively refresh existing measurements after a state-consistency check. Both streams constrain the same poses, inverse depths, and optional cam- era intrinsics through a single dense bundle adjustment. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistently strong trajectory estimation and improved dense reconstruction in both calibrated and uncalibrated settings. Notably, the uncalibrated configuration reduces the average ATE RMSE from 0.030 m for the strongest feed-forward baseline to 0.002 m on the Replica dataset.

AI.tldr: F2SLAM将前馈3D几何直接转化为优化原生的目标权重测量，附加到持久稠密因子图上，通过高频与低频双流约束同一组位姿、逆深度与相机内参，实现单次稠密BA。
AI.motivation: 在线SLAM主要依赖局部测量，长序列易累积漂移；前馈3D模型虽具强多视图几何先验，但现有结合方式多将其视为外部几何状态，在事后对齐或融合，使多视图证据被排除在精化SLAM状态的优化器之外。
AI.method: 构建持久稠密因子图；高频流维持局部跟踪约束与图连通性；低频流利用更广多视图上下文，在状态一致性检查后选择性刷新已有测量；两流通过单次稠密束调整共同约束位姿、逆深度及可选相机内参。
AI.result: 在多个基准上实现稳定的轨迹估计，并在标定与非标定设置下改善稠密重建；非标定配置在Replica数据集上将平均ATE RMSE从最强前馈基线的0.030 m降至0.002 m。
AI.conclusion: 将前馈几何内化为优化原生测量可有效结合前馈先验与在线SLAM，在标定与非标定场景下同时提升轨迹精度与稠密重建质量。

title: Safe Context Switching for Agents in the Wild: Mitigating Subspace Interference via Orthogonal Adaptation
summary: Most Large Language Models exhibit a fundamental tension between two sequential tasks, such as logical reasoning and safety alignment. The high-variance internal states required for sophisticated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) deduction can geometrically interfere with latent representations encoding safety constraints. We identify this phenomenon as Sequential Subspace Interference, showing that standard fine-tuning on logical tasks such as multi-step mathematics and code generation can result in a 23.3% interference penalty on alignment benchmarks, substantially weakening the model's safety priors. This Reasoning Drift is not adequately captured by current adaptation methods because gradients for logical tasks are rarely orthogonal to safety objectives. To address this issue, we propose AURA (Adaptive Unique Residual Allocation), a spectral regularization framework that enforces Spectral Independence between reasoning and safety. By explicitly estimating the null space of the alignment manifold and constraining reasoning updates to its orthogonal complement, AURA enables models to improve logical reasoning without compromising safety. Empirically, AURA recovers 23.0% of the lost performance while preserving greater than 0.98 cosine fidelity to the safe state, demonstrating that reasoning and alignment can be effectively decoupled through geometric regularization.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了大模型顺序任务间的"子空间干扰"现象，提出谱正则化框架AURA，通过约束推理更新落在对齐流形零空间的正交补上，实现推理与安全解耦。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在顺序任务（如逻辑推理与安全对齐）之间存在根本性张力：复杂思维链推理所需的高方差内部状态会与编码安全约束的潜在表示发生几何干扰。现有适配方法无法充分处理这一"推理漂移"问题，因为逻辑任务的梯度很少与安全目标正交，导致在多步数学、代码生成等逻辑任务上微调会产生23.3%的对齐干扰损失，显著削弱模型的安全先验。
AI.method: 提出AURA（自适应唯一残差分配），一种谱正则化框架，强制在推理与安全之间建立"谱独立性"。具体做法是显式估计对齐流形的零空间，并将推理更新约束到其正交补空间内，从而使模型在提升逻辑推理能力的同时不损害安全性。
AI.result: AURA恢复了对齐基准上损失的23.0%性能，同时对安全状态保持大于0.98的余弦保真度，验证了通过几何正则化可有效解耦推理与对齐。
AI.conclusion: 推理与安全对齐可以通过几何正则化实现有效解耦，AURA为代表的谱独立性约束为缓解顺序子空间干扰提供了可行路径。

title: Look Before You Leap: Thermodynamic Arbitration of Parametric and Non-Parametric Knowledge in LLM Agents via Self-Regulating Memory Architectures
summary: The architecture of modern LLMs consists of a profound cognitive polarization. LLMs possess implicit intuition encoded in their parameters, yet rely on a disconnected, explicit mechanism to access the outside world. Agentic frameworks have not bridged this gap; instead, models are often compelled into pathological "induced amnesia." Under the prevailing "Retrieve-Always" paradigm, agents must distrust their internal knowledge, making every user interaction a "tabula rasa" event that must be checked externally. This creates reflexive dependence that can be thermodynamically wasteful, cognitively fragile, and susceptible to irrelevant context. We propose a return to first principles, operationalizing the biological maxim "Look Before You Leap." We introduce MARTA (Metacognitive Adaptive Retrieval and Thought Architecture), a neuro-symbolic framework that bridges parametric and non-parametric knowledge. Rather than treating retrieval as mandatory, MARTA models it as a cost, taking the leap only when perceived internal inadequacy warrants external information. By allowing the agent to gauge the entropy of its own thoughts before acting, MARTA enables deliberative retrieval and uncertainty-aware decision making. Our approach suggests that giving agents the capacity for introspection can restore a more efficient balance between internal knowledge and external information.

AI.tldr: MARTA是一个神经符号框架，将检索建模为成本，通过自省内部认知熵来决定是否检索，从而在参数化知识与非参数化知识间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM存在认知极化：参数中编码隐含直觉，却依赖脱节的显式机制访问外部世界。现有"始终检索"范式迫使智能体不信任内部知识，导致每次交互都成为"白板"，产生反射性依赖，造成热力学浪费、认知脆弱，并易受无关上下文干扰。
AI.method: 提出MARTA（元认知自适应检索与思维架构），回归第一性原理，践行"三思而后行"的生物法则。该神经符号框架不将检索视为强制，而是将其建模为一种成本，仅在感知到内部知识不足时才"跳跃"获取外部信息。MARTA允许智能体在行动前评估自身思维的熵，实现深思熟虑的检索与不确定性感知的决策。
AI.result: MARTA通过在行动前评估自身思维熵，实现了深思熟虑的检索和不确定性感知的决策，使智能体能够感知内部不足后再触发外部检索。
AI.conclusion: 赋予智能体内省能力，可恢复内部知识与外部信息之间更高效的平衡。

title: PixReenact: Pixel-Conditioned Causal Video Diffusion for Streaming Head-Avatar Reenactment
summary: Streaming head-avatar reenactment aims to animate a reference image according to a live driving video, requiring robust motion transfer, long-term identity stability, and low latency. Existing methods often rely on specialized identity or motion representations, which can discard useful visual information and inherit failure modes from external extractors. In addition, many recent diffusion-based reenactment methods use offline, clip-based generation, jointly processing and denoising an entire video clip before producing its output, making continuous low-latency streaming difficult. We introduce PixReenact, a pixel-conditioned streaming reenactment framework built on causal video diffusion. PixReenact conditions directly on VAE-encoded reference and driving frames, without specialized identity or motion representations. To separate reference identity from driver motion, we train with cross-identity pseudo supervision together with corrective objectives anchored to the original reference and driving inputs. Long self-rollouts reduce autoregressive drift, while state-aware dual-teacher distillation separately addresses cold-start and steady-state generation. Across three cross-identity benchmarks and a long-horizon streaming benchmark, PixReenact demonstrates robust cross-identity reenactment, particularly under challenging conditions such as extreme viewpoints, occlusions, and pronounced facial expressions, while maintaining the reference identity over long streams. A 4-NFE rolling student continuously emits four frames per update with a mean emission latency of 239 ms.

AI.tldr: PixReenact：基于因果视频扩散的像素条件流式头像重演框架，无需专用身份/运动表示，实现长时身份稳定与低延迟连续生成。
AI.motivation: 流式头像重演需兼顾鲁棒的动捕迁移、长期身份一致性与低延迟。现有方法依赖专用身份或运动表示，会丢弃有用视觉信息并继承外部提取器的失效模式；且近期扩散式重演多为离线、基于片段的整段去噪，难以实现连续低延迟流式生成。
AI.method: 提出 PixReenact，基于因果视频扩散，直接以 VAE 编码的参考帧与驱动帧作为条件，不使用专用身份或运动表示。为解耦参考身份与驱动运动，采用跨身份伪监督联合以原始参考和驱动输入为锚的校正目标进行训练；通过长自回归 rollout 抑制自回归漂移；并用状态感知的双教师蒸馏分别处理冷启动与稳态生成。
AI.result: 在三个跨身份基准与一个长时流式基准上，PixReenact 展现鲁棒的跨身份重演，尤其在极端视角、遮挡与明显面部表情等困难条件下表现优异，并在长流中保持参考身份。4-NFE 滚动学生模型每次更新连续输出四帧，平均发出延迟 239 ms。
AI.conclusion: PixReenact 以像素条件因果扩散统一解决身份稳定、运动迁移与低延迟流式生成的矛盾，验证了无需专用表示即可实现高质量长时跨身份头像重演。

title: DTFormer: Text-Guided Semantic Alignment for RGB-D Segmentation
comment: This is submitted to IEEE Journal
summary: RGB-D semantic segmentation has made notable progress by fusing RGB and Depth, yet mainstream models still learn features almost exclusively from pixel-level supervision, lacking direct high-level semantic constraints. This raises a central question-can external knowledge such as language priors inject stronger semantic discriminability into mainstream RGB-D segmentation models. We present DTFormer, a novel tri-modal (RGB-D-Text) semantic segmentation framework. At its core is Text-guided Semantic Alignment Module (TSAM) that first encodes textual cues into a set of semantic prototypes and then explicitly aligns multi-modal RGB-D features with these prototypes at multiple encoder and decoder layers. This design imposes strong semantic regularization on representation learning, guiding the network toward more discriminative features. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that DTFormer delivers consistent gains while remaining simple and efficient. Our results demonstrate that explicit semantic alignment offers an effective and practical route to improving RGB-D semantic segmentation. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出DTFormer三模态（RGB-D-文本）语义分割框架，通过文本引导语义对齐模块（TSAM）将文本先验编码为语义原型，并在多层级显式对齐RGB-D特征，以强语义正则提升判别性。
AI.motivation: 现有RGB-D语义分割虽在RGB与Depth融合上取得进展，但主流模型几乎只依赖像素级监督，缺乏直接的高层语义约束，因此语义判别性受限；作者希望验证外部语言先验能否为模型注入更强语义辨别能力。
AI.method: 核心为TSAM：先将文本线索编码为一组语义原型，再在编码器与解码器的多个层级上，将多模态RGB-D特征与这些原型进行显式对齐，从而在表示学习过程中施加强语义正则化。
AI.result: 在多个基准上实验显示DTFormer取得一致性性能提升，同时保持结构简单、效率较高。
AI.conclusion: 显式语义对齐为改进RGB-D语义分割提供了一条有效且实用的路径；代码将在论文接收后开源。

title: templar: agentic induction and evolution of standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora
summary: Structured radiology reporting mitigates the heterogeneity of free-text reports, yet its benefits depend on high-quality reporting templates. In practice, such templates are conventionally built through labor-intensive expert consensus and therefore vary across institutions and lag behind evolving clinical practice. Large language models (LLMs) enable automated template induction, but existing approaches remain limited: single-LLM induction is constrained by context length, and the corpus-scale method ASTAR produces a static, closed-corpus template without external grounding or downstream adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TEMPLAR, a TEMPLate-centric Agentic framework for inducing and evolving standardized Radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora. TEMPLAR treats the template as a persistent central state maintained alongside two provenance-aware knowledge graphs, namely an anatomical graph that constrains template construction and a diagnostic graph that supports finding-to-diagnosis reasoning. Three agents operate on this state. The Induction Agent derives canonical clinical slots from anatomy-constrained Span-Triple atoms via dual-view similarity clustering; the Evolution Agent then assembles these slots into a hierarchical template and revises it under consistency constraints, external clinical evidence, and downstream structuring feedback; and the Clinical Agent applies the evolved template to report structuring, reconstruction, and diagnostic reasoning. Across four datasets, TEMPLAR outperforms ASTAR, three medical LLMs, and six general-purpose LLMs in coverage, information fidelity, and diagnostic fidelity, while achieving the highest or tied-highest LLM-rated template quality. Its fidelity advantages over ASTAR persist under cross-dataset transfer, and cumulative ablations support complementary contributions of its key components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TEMPLAR——一个以模板为中心的智能体框架，能够从大规模临床语料中自动归纳并持续演化标准化的放射学报告模板，并通过三个智能体在双层知识图约束下实现模板构建、修订与临床应用，在四个数据集上优于ASTAR、医学LLM与通用LLM。
AI.motivation: 结构化报告可缓解自由文本报告的异质性，但其效果依赖高质量模板。现实中模板多依赖专家共识人工构建，导致机构间差异大且滞后于临床实践演进。已有LLM自动化方案存在不足：单LLM归纳受上下文长度限制；语料级方法ASTAR生成的是静态、封闭语料模板，缺乏外部依据与下游适配能力。
AI.method: TEMPLAR将模板视为持续维护的中心状态，并配以两类溯源感知知识图：约束模板构建的解剖图与支持"征象—诊断"推理的诊断图。三个智能体围绕该状态运作：归纳智能体通过双视角相似度聚类，从解剖约束的Span-Triple原子中提取规范临床槽位；演化智能体将槽位组装为层级化模板，并在一致性约束、外部临床证据与下游结构化反馈下进行修订；临床智能体将演化后的模板应用于报告结构化、重建与诊断推理。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，TEMPLAR在覆盖度、信息保真度与诊断保真度方面均优于ASTAR、三个医学LLM与六个通用LLM，并获得最高或并列最高的LLM评分模板质量。其相对ASTAR的保真度优势在跨数据集迁移下依然保持，累积消融实验验证了各关键组件的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: TEMPLAR通过"中心模板状态+双知识图+三智能体"的闭环设计，克服了单LLM上下文受限与ASTAR静态封闭的局限，实现了可外部依据、可下游适配、可持续演化的放射学报告模板自动构建，为结构化报告提供可扩展的高质量模板方案。

title: ArticuTable: Generating Instance-Level Interactive Rigid-Articulated 3D Tabletop Scenes from a Single Image
summary: Embodied agents benefit from 3D environments that combine visual fidelity to real-world observations with physical interactivity. Existing single-image tabletop reconstruction methods recover plausible scene geometry but typically represent objects as monolithic rigid bodies, limiting interaction to whole-object rigid motion and precluding executable part-level articulation. Meanwhile, recovering a scene layout consistent with the input view remains challenging because a single observation may admit multiple plausible pose-scale configurations. We present ArticuTable, a single-image 3D tabletop reconstruction framework that recovers both executable part-level articulation and an input-view-consistent scene layout. For object modeling, we introduce generation-robust articulation modeling (GRAM), which combines joint fitting guided by a multimodal large language model with semantic state reasoning to recover reliable joint parameters and valid motion ranges from imperfect monolithic proxy meshes, thereby converting them into executable articulated assets. For scene layout, we introduce progressive semantic-geometric scene registration (PSGSR), which progressively narrows the pose-scale search space under complementary metric, planar, and input-view constraints and resolves orientation ambiguity through structure-aware semantic correspondences, yielding a scene layout consistent with the input view. We further contribute ArticuTable-100, a curated collection of 100 simulation-ready tabletop scenes. Extensive evaluation, including a user study, demonstrates strong performance across visual fidelity, input-view consistency, articulation quality, physical plausibility, and simulation readiness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ArticuTable，一个单图像桌面3D重建框架，同时恢复可执行的部件级关节运动和与输入视角一致的场景布局。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像桌面重建方法虽能恢复合理的场景几何，但通常将物体表示为整体刚体，只能进行整物体刚体运动，无法实现可执行的部件级关节运动；同时，单视角观测可能存在多种合理的位姿-尺度配置，导致场景布局与输入视角难以保持一致。
AI.method: 提出两个核心模块：(1) 生成鲁棒关节建模（GRAM），结合由多模态大语言模型引导的联合拟合与语义状态推理，从非完美的整体代理网格中恢复可靠的关节参数与有效运动范围，将其转化为可执行的关节化资产；(2) 渐进式语义-几何场景配准（PSGSR），在度量、平面和输入视角等互补约束下逐步缩小位姿-尺度搜索空间，并通过结构感知的语义对应解决朝向歧义。
AI.result: 构建了 ArticuTable-100，包含100个可直接用于仿真的桌面场景集合；大量评估（含用户研究）显示在视觉保真度、输入视角一致性、关节质量、物理合理性和仿真可用性方面均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: ArticuTable 通过部件级关节建模与渐进式场景配准，实现了单图像桌面场景的输入视角一致重建与可执行交互，并提供仿真就绪的数据集，推进了具身智能体可交互3D环境构建。

title: MGPO: Manifold-Guided Diffusion Alignment for Task-Aware Dataset Distillation
summary: Diffusion-based dataset distillation (DD) suffers from a fundamental objective mismatch: likelihood-driven diffusion models prioritize density approximation over the discriminative decision boundaries required for downstream tasks. Beyond semantic mismatch, relying solely on density also leads to geometric coverage loss, where generated samples collapse into a few high-density modes and fail to cover the manifold's structural diversity. We propose Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization (MGPO), which reformulates DD as a multi-objective reinforcement learning problem and achieves Dual-Space Alignment via a pixel-space discriminative reward and a latent-space geometric reward guided by a class-wise Minimum Spanning Tree (MST). The discriminative reward enforces class separability, while the MST-based geometric reward encourages generated latents to cover a sparse geometric skeleton of each class, jointly addressing both failure modes. We further provide an idealized analysis that motivates the MST-based reward, including a Hausdorff approximation bound and a subsampling bound independent of the dataset size. The reward-modular design extends to structured tasks such as object detection and segmentation by substituting the frozen task reward model. Extensive experiments show MGPO consistently outperforms existing methods, including a +8.0% mIoU gain on segmentation under low-budget settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MGPO，将基于扩散的数据集蒸馏重构为多目标强化学习问题，通过像素空间判别奖励与基于类别最小生成树的潜空间几何奖励实现双空间对齐，在分类、检测、分割任务上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的数据集蒸馏存在根本性的目标错配：似然驱动的扩散模型侧重密度近似，而非下游任务所需的判别性决策边界。此外，仅依赖密度还会导致几何覆盖损失，生成样本坍缩到少数高密度模式，无法覆盖流形的结构多样性。
AI.method: 提出Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization（MGPO），将数据集蒸馏重构为多目标强化学习问题，通过双空间对齐实现：像素空间的判别奖励用于增强类别可分性；潜空间的几何奖励由类别级最小生成树（MST）引导，促使生成潜变量覆盖各类别的稀疏几何骨架。并提供理想化分析支持MST奖励设计，包括Hausdorff近似界与与数据集规模无关的子采样界。该奖励模块化设计可通过替换冻结的任务奖励模型扩展到目标检测、分割等结构化任务。
AI.result: 大量实验表明MGPO持续优于现有方法，在低预算设置下的分割任务上取得+8.0% mIoU提升。
AI.conclusion: MGPO通过将判别奖励与基于MST的几何奖励结合的多目标强化学习框架，同时缓解语义错配与几何覆盖损失，验证了双空间对齐在数据集蒸馏中的有效性，并具备向结构化下游任务扩展的通用性。

title: Anchor and Adapt: Asymmetric Prompt Adaptation for Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: In few-shot industrial anomaly detection, the few normal target images provide no direct defect supervision, making anomaly prompts difficult to learn from these samples alone. Some vision-language methods therefore use manually specified descriptions to supply explicit anomaly semantics. However, constructing these descriptions requires product-specific effort, and their effectiveness depends on prompt selection. We propose Anchor and Adapt, a two-stage prompt learning framework that separates the acquisition of anomaly semantics from adaptation to target normal appearance. Stage I learns transferable normal and abnormal anchors from annotated auxiliary data. Stage II keeps these anchors fixed and adapts an additional normal branch using the few target normal samples. The inherited and adapted normal branches jointly characterize target normality, with text-anchor regularization encouraging consistency with the generic normal prior and separation from the abnormal anchors. This design retains learned anomaly knowledge while reducing dependence on category-specific anomaly templates, without requiring synthetic anomaly generation. Cross-dataset experiments between MVTec-AD and VisA under 1-, 2-, and 4-shot settings demonstrate competitive detection and localization performance. Controlled ablations assess the roles of transferred anchors, asymmetric adaptation, dual-normal representations, and anchor regularization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Anchor and Adapt"两阶段提示学习框架，将异常语义获取与目标正常外观适配解耦，无需人工描述或合成异常即可实现少样本工业异常检测。
AI.motivation: 少样本工业异常检测中，少量正常目标图像不含直接缺陷监督，异常提示难以从中学习；现有视觉-语言方法依赖人工指定描述提供异常语义，需针对产品定制且效果受提示选择影响。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：Stage I 从带标注辅助数据学习可迁移的正常与异常锚点（anomaly anchors）；Stage II 固定这些锚点，用少量目标正常样本适配一个额外的正常分支。继承的正常分支与适配的正常分支共同刻画目标正常性，并通过文本锚点正则（text-anchor regularization）鼓励与通用正常先验一致、与异常锚点分离；无需合成异常生成。
AI.result: 在 MVTec-AD 与 VisA 的跨数据集实验（1/2/4-shot）中取得有竞争力的检测与定位性能；受控消融验证了迁移锚点、非对称适配、双正常表征及锚点正则的作用。
AI.conclusion: 该设计在保留已学异常知识的同时，降低对类别特定异常模板的依赖，避免了人工描述与合成异常生成的需求。

title: Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting for Diffusion Sampling Acceleration
summary: We propose Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting (HybridFF), a training-free, plug-and-play framework for accelerating diffusion sampling. To capture local smoothness, long-range trends, and complex non-monotonic variations when modeling feature evolution, HybridFF first estimates coefficients using moving least squares (MLS) for each of multiple complementary basis families and then combines the corresponding predictors using fusion weights. In addition to the choice of basis functions, the fusion weights also play a critical role. We introduce two strategies to balance quality and speedup. HybridFF (Fixed) prioritizes efficiency with model-specific fusion weights calibrated on a small set and held constant during inference. HybridFF (Adaptive) updates the fusion weights online using branch reliability scores computed from an exponential moving average of full-step prediction errors, improving prediction fidelity and generation quality under aggressive caching while retaining substantial acceleration. Experiments across DiT-XL/2, FLUX.1-dev, SD3.5-Large, and HunyuanVideo demonstrate a favorable speedup--quality trade-off over representative single-basis forecasters and caching baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 HybridFF，一种免训练、即插即用的扩散采样加速框架，通过多基函数预测器融合建模特征演化。
AI.motivation: 扩散采样推理开销大，现有单基函数预测器难以同时刻画特征的局部平滑、长程趋势与非单调变化，缓存加速在激进设置下质量下降。
AI.method: 先用移动最小二乘法（MLS）为多个互补基函数族分别估计系数并得到预测器，再以融合权重组合。Fixed 策略在小集合上校准模型专属权重并保持恒定以提升效率；Adaptive 策略用全步预测误差的指数移动平均计算分支可靠性分数，在线更新融合权重。
AI.result: 在 DiT-XL/2、FLUX.1-dev、SD3.5-Large 与 HunyuanVideo 上，相比代表性单基预测器与缓存基线，取得更优的加速—质量权衡；Adaptive 在激进缓存下提升保真度与生成质量并保持显著加速。
AI.conclusion: 基函数选择与融合权重均关键，多基融合的免训练框架可有效加速扩散采样并兼顾质量。

title: When and What to Prune? Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Efficient VLA
summary: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate vision-language models and is especially useful for vision-language-action (VLA) inference, where many visual tokens must be processed before predicting robot actions. Existing pruning methods usually estimate which tokens can be pruned based on attention scores or feature diversity, retaining tokens that are either highly attended or visually different from others. However, most of them use fixed pruning schedules, such as pruning once at a preset layer or pruning at uniformly spaced layers. Such schedules can be risky for VLA models, because the model may not know which visual regions matter for the action in early layers. Tokens that look unimportant at first may become useful after the model combines visual observations with the language instruction. In this work, we propose SAPrune, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient VLA inference. Instead of pruning at fixed layers, SAPrune uses a small calibration set to observe how action-to-visual attention changes across layers, and chooses pruning layers only after the attention pattern becomes more reliable. At each selected layer, SAPrune applies a dual-path pruning rule: one path protects strongly attended visual tokens from pruning, while the other prevents useful surrounding context from being discarded. Experiments on LIBERO, SIMPLER, and real-world robotic tasks show that SAPrune prunes 87.5% of visual tokens and achieves up to 1.718x inference speedup while maintaining competitive task success rates.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的视觉token剪枝框架SAPrune，通过校准集动态选择剪枝层并采用双路径剪枝规则，在VLA推理中剪掉87.5%视觉token并实现最高1.718倍加速。
AI.motivation: 视觉token剪枝可加速视觉-语言模型，尤其适用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）推理，因为预测机器人动作前需处理大量视觉token。但现有剪枝方法多采用固定剪枝计划（预设层剪枝或等间隔层剪枝），在VLA中存在风险：早期层模型尚不清楚哪些视觉区域对动作重要，起初看似不重要的token可能在结合语言指令后变得有用。
AI.method: SAPrune为免训练的视觉token剪枝框架。不采用固定层剪枝，而是使用小型校准集观察动作到视觉的注意力随层的变化，仅在注意力模式变得可靠后才选择剪枝层；在每个选定层应用双路径剪枝规则：一条路径保护强注意力视觉token不被剪枝，另一条路径防止有用的周边上下文被丢弃。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、SIMPLER及真实机器人任务上，SAPrune剪掉87.5%的视觉token，实现最高1.718倍推理加速，同时保持有竞争力的任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于注意力可靠性动态选择剪枝层与双路径剪枝规则，SAPrune在免训练条件下显著降低VLA推理的视觉token开销并提升速度，同时维持任务成功率，验证了自适应剪枝计划优于固定剪枝计划。

title: Answer with Evidence: Consistency-Aware Grounded Visual Question Answering for Roadside Traffic Scenes
summary: Roadside traffic reasoning requires every free-form textual claim to be backed by visual evidence. Existing grounded multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently exhibit say-point mismatch, in which the textual answer contradicts the bounding boxes the model localizes. Evaluation metrics that score answers and boxes separately leave this failure unpenalized. We trace the mismatch to the conventional answer-then-ground factorization, which commits to a numerical claim before any object is enumerated. To measure it, we build RoadSceneVQA-G, a benchmark of 34.7K question-answer pairs in which every free-form answer is linked to the set of boxes that witnesses it, and we propose the Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC) evaluation suite. To address it, we introduce Enumerate-then-Answer (EtA), which reverses the generation order so that answer-evidence agreement becomes a property of the output structure, and Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO), a reinforcement learning stage that uses the union of multiple rollouts as a recall teacher without ground-truth boxes. EtA raises say-point consistency from 26.6\% to 93.7\% and grounding F1 from 52.2\% to 73.0\%, and ECPO further increases F1 to 75.6\% without per-box supervision. On gRefCOCO, the same framework outperforms the strongest compared method, indicating that it transfers beyond traffic scenes. The project is available at https://github.com/GuanRunwei/RoadSceneVQA-G.

AI.tldr: 论文发现"先答后定位"范式导致say-point不一致，提出EtA反转生成顺序并配合ECPO强化学习，使一致性从26.6%提升到93.7%，F1从52.2%提升到75.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有grounded MLLM在路侧交通推理中存在"say-point mismatch"（文本答案与定位框矛盾），而将答案与框分开评分的指标无法惩罚这一失败；作者将问题根源追溯到传统的"先答后定位"分解方式，即在枚举任何物体前就已确定数值化答案。
AI.method: 1) 构建RoadSceneVQA-G基准，含34.7K问答对，每个自由形式答案都与其证据框集合关联；2) 提出Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC)评测套件；3) 提出Enumerate-then-Answer (EtA)，反转生成顺序，使答案-证据一致性成为输出结构的固有属性；4) 提出Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO)，用多次rollout的并集作为recall teacher，无需GT框的强化学习阶段。
AI.result: EtA将say-point一致性从26.6%提升至93.7%，grounding F1从52.2%提升至73.0%；ECPO在无逐框监督下进一步将F1提升至75.6%。在gRefCOCO上同框架超越最强对比方法，表明可迁移至交通场景之外。
AI.conclusion: 通过反转生成顺序使一致性内化为结构属性，并借助无GT框的强化学习进一步提升定位性能，该框架在交通与通用场景均有效。

title: Inductive Claims Extraction at Scale
summary: A large part of political discourse on social media is built and expressed at a level of claims: i.e. declarative, typically single-clause statements, which convey a particular interpretation of reality and can range from factual to evaluative. Moreover, rather than occurring randomly, claims coalesce, recur in patterns, and come to be associated with different world views. When paired with structural computational tools such as Social Network Analysis, claims can be a powerful unit of analysis to study political phenomena such as echo chambers or polarisation. In this paper, we present a pipeline that uses a large language model (LLM) to inductively extract and catalogue claims from large social media corpora, and apply it to two different Twitter datasets: one relating to the 2020 US presidential election and the other to the 2022 FIFA World Cup. We comprehensively evaluate the approach by measuring the pipeline's recall and precision against manually annotated samples, run ablation studies isolating the contribution of its various components, and perform a qualitative error analysis. We discuss the value of the approach in the context of Computational Social Science research, and illustrate its capabilities by presenting the claims catalogue obtained from each dataset.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一套基于大语言模型（LLM）的流水线，从大规模社交媒体语料中归纳式抽取并编目"主张"（claims），并在两个Twitter数据集上评估其有效性。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体政治话语大量以"主张"（陈述性、通常为单句的表述，传达对现实的特定解读）为单位构建；这些主张并非随机出现，而是反复聚合并与不同世界观相关联。结合社会网络分析等结构化计算工具，主张可成为研究政治极化、回音室等现象的有力分析单元，但缺乏从大规模语料中系统抽取与编目的方法。
AI.method: 提出一条利用大语言模型（LLM）归纳式抽取与编目主张的流水线，并应用于两个Twitter数据集：2020年美国总统选举与2022年FIFA世界杯。评估方式包括：以人工标注样本衡量流水线的召回率与精确率、针对各组件开展消融实验、进行定性错误分析。
AI.result: 通过人工标注对比给出了流水线在召回率和精确率上的表现，消融实验量化了各组成模块的贡献，定性错误分析揭示了主要失效模式；同时展示了两个数据集各自得到的主张目录（claims catalogue）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在计算社会科学研究中具有价值，能够以主张为单元支撑政治现象研究；论文通过展示两个数据集的主张目录说明了其实际能力。

title: Mind the Gaps: From Failure Attribution to Closed-Form Repair of Code Language Models
summary: Code language models must be maintained like the software around them: when a library evolves, a model keeps writing the interface that it saw during training. Repairing the model itself lets one correction reach all downstream uses. Existing repair methods attribute a failure to neurons, select the highest-ranked ones, and apply a generic update. This pipeline assumes that the attributed neurons are the ones to patch and that a generic update fits every failure, and neither assumption has been examined. We examine both on executable API evolution tasks in Python and Rust with three code models and identify two gaps. The targeting gap separates the neurons that failure attribution targets from the neurons that can carry a patch: their top sets have a Jaccard overlap of only 0.15 to 0.20. The tailoring gap separates a generic update from a patch built for the failure: the patches that different carrier neurons need are nearly orthogonal. To address both gaps, we propose ASTRA. It targets neurons by contrastive semantics, an attribution that scores a neuron by its contribution to the logit contrast between the target token and the produced token. It then tailors the patch by solving one small linear system in closed form, which corrects all failing tokens of a sample jointly and needs neither an optimizer nor a backward pass. Contrastive semantics selects significantly better carrier neurons than gradient-based attributions in 3 of 6 settings and comparable ones in the others. On average, ASTRA reaches 66.7 percent Pass@1, against 48.4 percent for the best of AlphaEdit, STAR and low-rank adaptation, and repairs a sample in 2.7 seconds. It is the best method in all 6 settings and for every type of API change, and this advantage persists under an unseen phrasing of the test prompt. Its side effects on unrelated code are small on the large models and larger on the small one.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究代码语言模型在库接口演化后的修复问题，指出既有方法存在"定位差距"与"定制差距"，提出ASTRA方法，通过对比语义定位神经元并以闭式线性求解定制补丁，在Python和Rust的API演化任务上显著优于AlphaEdit、STAR和LoRA。
AI.motivation: 代码语言模型在训练后固化了对旧版库接口的记忆，库演化会导致模型持续生成过时接口。修复模型本身可使一次修正惠及所有下游用途。现有修复流程假设"被归因的神经元即为应修补的神经元"且"通用更新适用于所有失败"，但这两个假设均未被检验。
AI.method: 作者在Python和Rust的可执行API演化任务上，用三种代码模型检验上述假设，发现两个差距：(1)定位差距——失败归因所指向的神经元与能承载补丁的神经元之间的Top集合Jaccard重叠仅0.15~0.20；(2)定制差距——不同承载神经元所需补丁近乎正交。据此提出ASTRA：以"对比语义"归因，按神经元对目标token与已生成token之间logit对比的贡献打分来定位神经元；再通过求解一个小型线性系统闭式地定制补丁，联合修正一个样本的所有失败token，无需优化器和反向传播。
AI.result: 对比语义在6个设置中的3个显著优于基于梯度的归因，其余设置相当。ASTRA平均Pass@1达66.7%，而AlphaEdit、STAR和低秩适配中最优者仅48.4%；修复单样本耗时2.7秒。在全部6个设置及每种API变更类型上均为最佳，且在测试提示的未见改写下优势依旧。对无关代码的副作用在大模型上较小，在小模型上较大。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型修复流程中"归因神经元即可修补"与"通用更新普适"两个假设不成立，存在定位与定制两重差距。ASTRA通过对比语义定位与闭式线性定制补丁同时弥补二者，在准确性、速度与跨设置稳健性上均取得领先，验证了针对性修补思路的有效性。

title: When Verifiable Counts Depend on Wording: Auditing Wording Robustness in Instruction Following
summary: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks often express each constraint through one fixed template. We test whether scores remain stable when the operational requirement is unchanged but its wording varies. We introduce WISE, a matched evaluation suite and reporting protocol instantiated on exact word count, keyword inclusion exactly once, and an inclusive 8--12 word range. Across 100 matched tasks, up to thirteen models from seven providers, and repeated generations scored over the complete visible output, wording alone produces substantial compliance shifts. In an avoidance-family panel, five avoidance and exclusion forms fall below the positive baseline, while constructional controls also shift compliance substantially: in the nine-model control panel, compliance is 54.9% for the original positive form, 48.2% for a longer positive form, 36.7% when the target appears later, and 33.8% for AVOID1. A strict JSON-structure probe shows wording sensitivity beyond counting, with a different direction of effect. Effect sizes, failure directions, weakest forms, and model rankings vary across realizations. Under the most disruptive exclusion form, the top-ranked model changes and 24.1% of strictly ordered model pairs reverse. Human validation further shows that unanimous agreement on an exact-count interpretation can coexist with substantially different model behavior. WISE supplements conventional scores with mean and worst-form compliance, wording gaps, failure profiles, and ranking stability.

AI.tldr: WISE评估套件揭示：在操作要求不变、仅改变措辞的情况下，指令遵循基准得分会出现显著波动，影响效应量、失败方向、最弱形式及模型排名。
AI.motivation: 现有可验证的指令遵循基准通常用固定模板表达每条约束，可能导致分数受措辞影响而不自知。作者希望检验：当操作要求相同但措辞变化时，模型得分是否仍然稳定。
AI.method: 提出WISE匹配评估套件与报告协议，实例化三种约束：精确词数、关键词恰好出现一次、8–12词（含端点）范围。构建100个匹配任务，覆盖来自7家提供方的至多13个模型，并对完整可见输出进行重复生成评分。设置规避族面板（5种规避/排除形式）与九模型构式对照组，另加入严格JSON结构探针，并进行人工验证。
AI.result: 仅措辞变化即造成显著合规率漂移：九模型对照组中，原始肯定形式合规率54.9%，较长肯定形式48.2%，目标后置36.7%，AVOID1为33.8%。严格JSON结构探针显示措辞敏感性超越计数，且效应方向不同。效应量、失败方向、最弱形式与模型排名随实现形式变化；在最具破坏性的排除形式下，榜首模型改变，24.1%的严格有序模型对发生排名反转。人工验证表明，对精确计数解释的一致认同可与显著不同的模型行为并存。
AI.conclusion: 指令遵循基准的措辞实现是评估中的关键混杂因素，单一模板分数不足以反映模型真实能力。WISE在传统分数之外补充均值合规率、最差形式合规率、措辞差距、失败画像与排名稳定性等指标。

title: Red-TTT: Test-Time Training for Automated Jailbreaking Large Language Models
summary: Large language models remain vulnerable to jailbreaks, and automated red teaming is the standard way to find jailbreaks in large language models at scale. Current methods either draw more samples at test time through search, rewriting, and tree expansion, or train a stronger attacker offline with reinforcement learning. Both share a limitation: once an attack on a specific target behavior begins, the attacker's weights are frozen. Any signal it gathers about the behavior stays in its context window and is discarded afterward. The attacker never adapts its proposal distribution mid-attack, so success depends almost entirely on the sampling budget, and under a budget affordable at scale, many behaviors remain unbroken. We propose Red-TTT, which updates the attacker's parameters during the attack on each behavior. At each round, the attacker samples a group of candidates, scores them against the victim's replies, and takes a policy-gradient step before drawing the next group, so what it discovers about the current victim is consolidated into weights rather than accumulated as context. We also adapt the training objective to red teaming, where success is judged by the single best sample rather than the average. Red-TTT requires only sampling access to the victim and integrates into existing attack pipelines with no other changes. Against the Best-of-N baseline, Red-TTT raises attack success rate from 55.9\% to 72.4\% on average at a budget of 120 samples, improving over the baseline in every configuration and cracking many behaviors previous method cannot. The code is available at https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/Red-TTT

AI.tldr: Red-TTT提出在攻击过程中对攻击者参数进行在线更新，将每个行为上学到的信号固化进权重，从而在同等采样预算下显著提升越狱成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化红队方法存在共同局限：测试时搜索/改写/树扩展方法仅靠增加采样，离线强化学习训练的攻击者在攻击开始后权重冻结，攻击过程中获得的关于目标行为的信息只停留在上下文窗口且随后被丢弃，攻击者的提议分布从不中途调整，导致成功率几乎完全依赖采样预算，在可规模化承受的预算下许多行为仍无法攻破。
AI.method: 提出Red-TTT，在针对每个行为的攻击过程中更新攻击者参数：每轮攻击者采样一组候选，依据受害模型的回复为其打分，在抽取下一组之前执行一步策略梯度更新，使发现的关于当前受害者的信息被固化到权重而非累积在上下文中。同时针对红队任务调整训练目标，以单个最佳样本而非平均表现来评判成功。该方法仅需对受害模型的采样访问权限，可直接集成进现有攻击流程而无需其他改动。
AI.result: 在120次采样的预算下，相比Best-of-N基线，Red-TTT将平均攻击成功率从55.9%提升至72.4%，在所有配置下均优于基线，并攻破了许多此前方法无法攻破的行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过在攻击过程中持续更新攻击者参数并采用面向最优样本的训练目标，Red-TTT突破了固定权重攻击者的采样预算瓶颈，为可扩展的自动化红队提供了更高效的方案，且易于集成到现有攻击管线中。

title: Mobile-4DGS: Unified Static-Dynamic Real-time Mobile Gaussian Splatting
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable performance in novel view synthesis, yet deploying both static and dynamic Gaussian representations on resource-constrained mobile devices remains challenging due to heavy storage, redundant primitives, and costly per-frame computation. We present Mobile-4DGS, a unified lightweight framework for high-fidelity real-time static and dynamic Gaussian rendering on mobile platforms. For compact appearance modeling, we introduce a Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator that compresses high-order radiance residuals into the first-order Spherical Harmonics (SH), together with an Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement module whose predicted offsets are pre-baked before inference. We further propose a Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning strategy to suppress redundant primitives while maintaining multi-view consistency. For dynamic scenes, we develop a compact explicit 4D representation by constructing second-order Gaussian motion, learnable temporal support, and a binary static-dynamic partition, enabling continuous-time modeling without runtime deformation networks. Based on this partition, a Depth-Order Certificate selectively reuses previously committed depth orders to reduce re-projection, sorting, merging, and index-buffer updates during playback. Extensive experiments on static and dynamic scenes demonstrate that Mobile-4DGS substantially reduces storage and rendering overhead while maintaining competitive visual quality, enabling real-time 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting on mobile devices. \textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}{Code has been released: https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}}.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mobile-4DGS 统一轻量框架，在移动端实现高保真实时的静态与动态高斯泼溅渲染。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 在新视角合成上表现优异，但在资源受限的移动设备上部署静态与动态高斯表示仍面临存储开销大、图元冗余、逐帧计算昂贵等挑战。
AI.method: 1) 蒙特卡洛镜面能量聚合器，将高阶辐射残差压缩进一阶球谐；2) 属性条件化球谐增强模块，预测偏移在推理前预烘焙；3) 多视角 Alpha 驱动的致密化与剪枝策略，抑制冗余图元并保持多视角一致性；4) 动态场景下构建二阶高斯运动、可学习时间支撑与二值静态-动态划分的紧凑显式 4D 表示，无需运行时形变网络即可连续时间建模；5) 基于该划分的深度顺序证书，选择性复用已提交深度顺序以减少重投影、排序、合并与索引缓冲更新。
AI.result: 在静态与动态场景的大量实验表明，Mobile-4DGS 在保持有竞争力视觉质量的同时显著降低存储与渲染开销。
AI.conclusion: 实现了移动设备上的实时 3D 与 4D 高斯泼溅，并已开源代码。

title: Calibrated Answers About Randomized Trials From a 4-Billion-Parameter Open Model: A Registered Test and a License-Clean Release
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Code, results files and the paper's sources: https://github.com/johann-e-li/fiorillo. Model: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10722. Registration: https://osf.io/kaxmn/
summary: Fiorillo v0.5 is an open model that answers typed questions with a probability for each answer. Its main specialist reads a randomized trial's article, cut to 6,144 tokens, and answers whether an intervention significantly increased, significantly decreased or did not significantly change an outcome against a comparator (Evidence Inference 2.0, EI). It is Qwen3-4B-Base with low-rank adapters and a decision head, fine-tuned for EI only on the 1,431 of 2,657 training articles whose own license allows reuse. Four criteria registered on the Open Science Framework before this version's test predictions decided its release, the second bar judged on EI's test split, whose labels are public. On that split (1,218 prompts in 333 articles), the expected calibration error was 0.0168 against a limit of 0.05; log loss was below the prior's by 0.8603 (95 percent interval 0.8104 to 0.9078) and below that of Gemma 4 31B-it, reading the same input, by 0.1829 (0.1164 to 0.2598); and macro-F1 was 0.9248 against 0.8668, so all four criteria passed. Training the same recipe on clean articles alone cost 0.0123 in accuracy (0.0034 to 0.0207; descriptive). With no article, macro-F1 fell to 0.4384; the title alone raised it by 0.0939 (0.0655 to 0.1234), which a title stating the result or recall of the trial could explain; exchanging intervention and comparator reversed 0.6652 of its direction answers. Run as released, the files matched the evaluated predictions within limits set in advance. The release is under the Apache License 2.0 (digital object identifier 10.57967/hf/10722).

AI.tldr: Fiorillo v0.5 是一个开源模型，针对 Evidence Inference 2.0 任务，用 Qwen3-4B-Base 微调后预测干预对结局的显著性方向，四项预注册标准全部通过。
AI.motivation: 使模型能够阅读随机试验文章并判断干预相对对照是否显著增加、显著减少或未显著改变某一结局，且以预先注册的标准约束发布，保证评测的可靠性。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-4B-Base 为基座，加低秩适配器与决策头，仅在 2,657 篇训练文章中许可允许复用的 1,431 篇上微调；输入文章截断至 6,144 token；发布前在 OSF 注册四条标准，第二条在 EI 测试集上判定。
AI.result: 测试集（333 篇文章、1,218 条提示）上：ECE 0.0168（限值 0.05）；log loss 较先验低 0.8603（95% 区间 0.8104–0.9078），较同输入 Gemma 4 31B-it 低 0.1829（0.1164–0.2598）；macro-F1 0.9248 对 0.8668，四项标准全部通过。仅在干净文章上训练准确率损失 0.0123（0.0034–0.0207，描述性）；无文章时 macro-F1 降至 0.4384，仅标题提升 0.0939（0.0655–0.1234）；交换干预与对照使 0.6652 的方向答案反转。
AI.conclusion: 发布版本运行所得文件与评测预测在预设限值内一致；模型以 Apache License 2.0 发布（DOI 10.57967/hf/10722）。

title: BossouChimpanzee: Long-term Chimpanzee Video Dataset
summary: We describe the BossouChimpanzee video dataset, a unique long-term visual record of wild chimpanzees at an outdoor laboratory for field experiments in Bossou, Guinea, spanning three decades (1988-2018) and comprising over 1,200 hours of continuous video recordings collected through collaborative fieldwork and research. In this paper, we outline the history and scientific contributions of the experimental paradigm and video archive, provide key statistics and details on the structure of the main video dataset, and release an initial ~74h snapshot, BossouChimpanzee70h, covering 23 identified individuals focused on chimpanzee individual and action recognition, ahead of the full video resource. This dataset represents a valuable resource for cognitive and behavioural research in ethology and a rich benchmark for training and evaluating machine learning models on audiovisual data from the wild.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍BossouChimpanzee视频数据集：基于几内亚Bossou野外实验站1988-2018年、逾1200小时的野生黑猩猩连续录像，先发布约74小时的快照BossouChimpanzee70h，涵盖23个已识别个体，用于个体与动作识别，服务于行为学与机器学习研究。
AI.motivation: 野生黑猩猩的长期连续视觉记录稀缺，现有数据多为短期或圈养场景，难以支撑认知与行为学的纵向研究，也缺少来自野外真实环境的视听基准来训练和评估机器学习模型。因此需要系统整理并公开发布长期野外视频档案。
AI.method: 以几内亚Bossou户外实验站的野外实验范式为依托，通过合作式野外工作与研究，采集并整理1988-2018年三十年间的连续视频记录，形成总量超1200小时的数据集；文中梳理该实验范式与视频档案的历史及科学贡献，给出主要数据集的结构、关键统计信息，并提前发布约74小时的初始快照BossouChimpanzee70h。
AI.result: 构建了跨度三十年、超1200小时的野生黑猩猩连续视频数据集，并发布约74小时的快照BossouChimpanzee70h，覆盖23个可识别个体，任务聚焦黑猩猩个体识别与动作识别；完整视频资源将在后续发布。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集既是动物行为学中认知与行为研究的宝贵资源，也为在野外视听数据上训练和评估机器学习模型提供了丰富基准；快照的先行发布有助于社区在完整资源公开前开展早期研究。

title: Revisiting Ground-Truth Synthesis from High-Speed Video: Exact Validity Conditions and an Audited Consumer Capture Corpus
summary: Motion-deblurring datasets are commonly synthesised by averaging $N$ consecutive high-frame-rate frames and labelling the result with the central frame. We show that this label is unbiased for every capture timing only when the window is odd and the frames' sample durations are equal. An even window shifts every label by a fixed fraction of the blur length, even under perfect timing. Unequal durations are subtler: their mean misalignment is zero, so dataset statistics cannot reveal them, yet when the offset cannot be read from the blur they convolve the supervision rather than adding noise to it. Auditing 51 smartphone clips recorded at a nominal 240 fps, we find 19 captured near 176 fps, a behaviour recorded only in the container's timing tables. In a controlled test the parity choice costs a fitted linear deblurring filter far more than these timing irregularities do, and interpolation labels, unlike blur labels, can be repaired with the true frame times. We provide a tool that checks both conditions without decoding, and will release the clips and their timing tables.

AI.tldr: 运动去模糊数据集常用的合成标签（取中心帧）仅在窗口长度为奇数且各帧采样时长相等时才是无偏的；偶数窗口会造成固定比例的标签偏移，非等时长则会把偏移卷积进监督信号。作者审计了51段标称240 fps的手机视频，发现19段实际接近176 fps，并提供了一个无需解码的条件检查工具。
AI.motivation: 运动去模糊数据集普遍通过平均N帧连续高帧率图像、并以中心帧作为标签来合成，但这一标注范式隐含的时序假设（窗口奇偶性与帧采样时长一致性）此前缺乏系统检验，标签偏移会被误当作噪声或直接被忽略。
AI.method: 从理论上分析平均N帧合成标签的对齐误差来源，区分偶数窗口（固定偏移）与非等采样时长（均值对齐误差为零、难以从数据统计中察觉）两种情形；随后审计51段标称240 fps的手机视频片段，通过容器中的时序表（timing tables）核对真实帧率；并进行受控实验，比较窗口奇偶性选择与帧率不规则性对拟合线性去模糊滤波器的影响，同时测试插值标签与模糊标签的可修复性；此外提供一个无需解码视频即可检查上述两个条件的工具。
AI.result: 理论证明：标签无偏需要窗口为奇数且各帧采样时长相等；偶数窗口即使时序完美也会使每个标签偏移固定比例的模糊长度；非等时长情形下均值错位为零，因此数据集统计量无法揭示，但当偏移无法从模糊中读出时，它会把监督信号卷积而不是引入噪声。审计发现51段片段中有19段实际以接近176 fps采集，该行为仅记录于容器的时序表中。受控实验表明，窗口奇偶性的选择对拟合线性去模糊滤波器的影响远大于这些时序不规则性；并且与模糊标签不同，插值标签可以借助真实帧时间进行修复。
AI.conclusion: 合成运动去模糊标签的无偏性依赖于严格的时序条件，实际采集设备常存在未在元数据中显式暴露的帧率偏差；因此数据集构建应显式校验窗口奇偶性与真实帧时间，并优先采用可修复的插值标签。作者提供无需解码的条件检查工具，并将公开视频片段及其时序表。

title: Kinematics-Centric Continuous Sign Language Retrieval with Gloss-Guided Boundary-Aware Alignment
summary: Sign language-text alignment remains a fundamental challenge for text-driven sign language understanding. Existing methods predominantly rely on appearance-heavy RGB representations, which entangle motion semantics with visual variations and lead to ambiguous motion-language grounding. In this paper, we reformulate sign language-text alignment in a structured kinematic space and propose a kinematics-centric framework that adopts 3D SMPL-X motion as the primary representation. By explicitly modeling the kinematic dynamics of signing in a unified motion space, our approach reduces reliance on appearance signals and yields more semantically consistent representations. To capture the compositional nature of sign language, we introduce a gloss-guided local alignment mechanism that leverages gloss temporal spans as weak supervision to decompose continuous motion into coherent segments and establish fine-grained motion-text correspondences, thereby reducing ambiguity in localizing word-level semantics in continuous signing. Furthermore, we develop a visual distillation strategy, where RGB signals serve as privileged supervision during training to provide complementary contextual cues, while being completely removed at inference time. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art bidirectional retrieval performance on CSL-Daily and competitive results on PHOENIX-2014T. These results highlight the effectiveness of kinematic representations and explicit local grounding for sign language-text alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以运动学为中心的手语-文本对齐框架，采用3D SMPL-X运动作为主表示，结合注释引导的局部对齐与视觉蒸馏策略，在CSL-Daily和PHOENIX-2014T上取得领先或具竞争力的双向检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有手语-文本对齐方法主要依赖外观密集的RGB表示，将运动语义与视觉变化纠缠在一起，导致运动-语言对应关系模糊；同时手语具有组合性，需要细粒度的词级对应，而连续手语中词级语义定位存在歧义。
AI.method: 1）在结构化运动学空间中重新定义手语-文本对齐，以3D SMPL-X运动为主要表示，显式建模手语的运动学动态，减少对外观信号的依赖；2）引入注释（gloss）引导的局部对齐机制，以注释时间跨度作为弱监督，将连续运动分解为连贯片段，建立细粒度运动-文本对应；3）设计视觉蒸馏策略，训练时以RGB信号作为特权监督提供互补上下文线索，推理时完全移除。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在CSL-Daily上取得最先进的双向检索性能，在PHOENIX-2014T上取得具竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了运动学表示与显式局部对齐对手语-文本对齐的有效性，表明摆脱外观依赖、采用结构化运动学空间与细粒度对应建模是提升该任务性能的有效途径。

title: RubricArmor: Adversarial Evolution Improves LLM-Based Rubric Generation
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides interpretable rewards for aligning large language models (LLMs) by evaluating responses against query-specific evaluation criteria. To construct rubrics at scale, a straightforward approach to LLM-based rubric generation is to prompt an LLM to generate a rubric directly from the query. However, rubrics directly generated by LLMs are vulnerable to reward hacking, since omitted or underspecified criteria allow the policy to obtain high rubric rewards with low-quality responses. Existing LLM-based rubric generation methods improve the granularity and coverage of the generated criteria but do not proactively guard against reward hacking. To address this limitation, we propose RubricArmor, an adversarial framework that exposes and mitigates potential reward hacking at the rubric generation stage before it occurs in subsequent RL. Specifically, RubricArmor performs adversarial evolution, in which an attack step and a repair step alternate over multiple rounds. The attack step simulates the reward hacking of the policy by constructing adversarial responses that satisfy the current rubric but fail to properly complete the task. The repair step then revises the rubric to detect the response defects exposed by the attack step while preserving other valid criteria. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RubricArmor outperforms competitive rubric generation baselines and translates into more effective downstream rubric-based RL.

AI.tldr: 提出 RubricArmor，一种对抗式框架，在评分标准生成阶段就暴露并缓解奖励攻击，通过“攻击-修复”多轮交替演化生成更鲁棒的评分标准，从而提升下游基于评分标准的强化学习效果。
AI.motivation: 基于评分标准（rubric）的强化学习可通过对查询特定评估准则打分，为对齐大语言模型提供可解释奖励。但直接用 LLM 从查询生成评分标准存在漏洞：遗漏或描述不充分的准则会让策略在低质量回答下仍获得高评分奖励，即奖励攻击。现有生成方法虽提升准则的细粒度与覆盖度，却未主动防御奖励攻击。
AI.method: RubricArmor 是一个对抗框架，在评分标准生成阶段提前暴露并缓解潜在奖励攻击。核心机制为对抗式演化：多轮交替执行攻击步骤与修复步骤。攻击步骤通过构造“满足当前评分标准但未能正确完成任务”的对抗性回答，模拟策略的奖励攻击行为；修复步骤据此修订评分标准，使其能检测攻击暴露的回答缺陷，同时保留其他有效准则。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RubricArmor 优于多个有竞争力的评分标准生成基线，并能转化为更有效的下游基于评分标准的强化学习效果。
AI.conclusion: 将奖励攻击的防御前置到评分标准生成阶段是可行且有效的；通过攻击-修复的对抗演化，可在下游 RL 之前主动消除被利用的漏洞，提升评分标准质量与对齐效果。

title: When Does Longer Reasoning Help? Predicting Mathematical Reasoning Through Discovery and Execution
summary: Test-time compute can improve mathematical reasoning, but can short-budget runs predict how mathematical reasoning scales with additional compute? We introduce a Discovery--Execution (DE) framework that predicts the aggregate held-out scaling curves through a convolution of strategy discovery and conditional execution. From independent short-budget attempts and oracle-sketch-conditioned runs, the framework estimates cumulative success along held-out reasoning trajectories under alternate compute allocations. We evaluate four models on 35 fresh Olympiad problems and non-geometry problems from IMO-ProofBench Advanced. Under the DE framework, near-saturated execution predicts geometric scaling, as observed for the GPT models. For Claude Opus 4.8, incorporating measured execution substantially improves held-out forecasts over geometric extrapolation across one- and two-arm allocations. As a secondary application, regularized DE (R-DE) decisions to continue or restart yield lower average regret than the best model-specific retrospective policy. Together, these results show that measuring conditional execution provides information about longer reasoning that short-budget success rates do not always capture.

AI.tldr: 提出Discovery–Execution（DE）框架，用短预算实验预测数学推理随算力扩展的曲线，在Olympiad与IMO-ProofBench Advanced上验证其优于几何外推。
AI.motivation: 测试时算力能提升数学推理，但能否用短预算运行预测更长算力下的表现尚不明确，需要一种可预测留出集扩展曲线的方法。
AI.method: 将聚合扩展曲线建模为"策略发现"与"条件执行"的卷积；利用独立短预算尝试与oracle-sketch条件下的运行，估计不同算力分配下留出推理轨迹的累积成功率，并提出正则化DE（R-DE）用于继续/重启决策。
AI.result: 在35道新Olympiad题及IMO-ProofBench Advanced非几何题、四个模型上评估：GPT模型呈近饱和执行，预测几何扩展；Claude Opus 4.8纳入实测执行后，在单臂与双臂分配下留出预测显著优于几何外推；R-DE的继续/重启决策平均遗憾低于各模型最佳回顾性策略。
AI.conclusion: 测量条件执行能提供短预算成功率未必捕捉到的长推理信息，DE框架可有效预测并指导算力分配。

title: Shadow Feature Refinement Network: Progressive Feature Refinement based on Knowledge Distillation for Effective Shadow Removal
summary: In the field of deep learning, has seen significant advancements; however, shadow removal remains a persistent challenge owing to the variable sizes and colors of shadows influenced by lighting conditions. This study proposes a novel shadow feature refinement network (SFR-Net), which leverages supervised learning, feature refinement loss, and knowledge distillation to enhance shadow removal performance. A dedicated post-processing algorithm is further introduced to restore natural color consistency in the generated shadow-free images. We evaluated our method on two public datasets: the adjusted image shadow triplet dataset (ISTD+) and the shadow removal dataset (SRD), which demonstrate strong generalization capabilities under diverse conditions. On ISTD+, our model achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 3.4627 and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.9382 across the entire image. On SRD, it recorded an RMSE of 4.3781 and an SSIM of 0.9341. These comprehensive results show that our approach performs competitively across both shadow and non-shadow regions while setting a promising direction for robust and perceptually natural shadow removal. Code is available at https://github.com/DongHyun99/SFRNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出阴影特征细化网络SFR-Net，结合监督学习、特征细化损失与知识蒸馏，并辅以后处理算法，实现自然一致的阴影去除。
AI.motivation: 阴影的大小和颜色随光照条件变化，导致阴影去除仍是深度学习领域的持续难题。
AI.method: 提出SFR-Net，采用监督学习、特征细化损失和知识蒸馏提升性能；并引入专用后处理算法恢复无阴影图像的自然色彩一致性。
AI.result: 在ISTD+上全图RMSE为3.4627、SSIM为0.9382；在SRD上RMSE为4.3781、SSIM为0.9341，在阴影与非阴影区域均具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在不同条件下泛化能力强，为鲁棒且感知自然的阴影去除指明了方向。

title: Beyond Refusal Patterns: Safe-Role Internalization for Robust and Generalizable LLM Safety Alignment
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit harmful or unsafe outputs. Existing safety alignment approaches, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), often require substantial attack-specific supervision and computational resources, while remaining susceptible to shallow safety alignment and over-refusal. To address these challenges, we introduce SSRFT(Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning), the first framework that reformulates safety alignment as the internalization of a predefined safe role. SSRFT constructs a Safe-Role Question-Answer (SRQA) dataset from psychometric questions, limited jailbreak prompts, and a safe-role description. Role-consistent responses are synthesized, validated, and expanded into diverse scenarios, enabling models to internalize safety-oriented values and principles rather than explicit refusal patterns. Experiments across multiple Base and Instruct models show that SSRFT achieves more robust and generalizable safety alignment than standard SFT. SSRFT shows substantially greater robustness to prefilling attacks and better generalization to unseen jailbreak domains, while reducing over-refusal on benign queries and preserving the model's general capabilities. These results establish safe-role internalization as an effective alternative to refusal-centric safety alignment. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful and toxic language.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SSRFT（Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning），首个将安全对齐重新表述为"内化预定义安全角色"的框架。通过从心理测量学问题、有限越狱提示与安全角色描述构建 SRQA 数据集，合成并验证角色一致回答，再扩展至多样化场景，使模型内化安全价值而非显式拒绝模式。实验表明其比标准 SFT 具有更稳健、更可泛化的安全性，对 prefilling 攻击更鲁棒，对未见越狱域泛化更好，同时降低良性查询上的过度拒绝并保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法（SFT、RLHF）存在两大痛点：一是需要大量针对特定攻击的监督信号与算力；二是仍易出现"浅层安全对齐"（shallow safety alignment）和"过度拒绝"（over-refusal）。作者希望摆脱以拒绝为中心的对齐范式，寻找更高效、更泛化且副作用更小的安全对齐路径。
AI.method: 核心思路是将安全对齐重构为"内化一个预定义的安全角色"。具体流程：1）构建 Safe-Role Question-Answer（SRQA）数据集，数据来源包括心理测量学问题、有限数量的越狱提示以及一段安全角色描述；2）合成角色一致（role-consistent）的回答并进行验证；3）将回答扩展为多样化场景，用于监督微调，从而让模型习得安全导向的价值观与原则，而不是记忆显式拒绝模板。
AI.result: 在多种 Base 与 Instruct 模型上的实验显示：SSRFT 相比标准 SFT 获得更稳健、更可泛化的安全对齐；对 prefilling 攻击的鲁棒性显著提升；对未见越狱域泛化更好；在良性查询上的过度拒绝减少；同时模型的通用能力得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了"安全角色内化"可作为以拒绝为中心的安全对齐的有效替代方案，为降低攻击特定监督依赖、缓解浅层对齐与过度拒绝问题提供了新范式。（注：论文包含有害与有毒语言的示例。）

title: Riemannian Shape Analysis of the Corpus Callosum in Kendall Space: Aging and Alzheimer's Disease
summary: The corpus callosum (CC) is a major white-matter structure and a well-established marker of brain aging, but most studies quantify it using scalar summaries that discard its boundary geometry. We present a Riemannian shape-space framework \cite{fletcher2013geodesic-regression} for analyzing age-related morphological change in the midsagittal CC, applied to the OASIS-1 cohort. Each contour is represented by $128$ landmarks and embedded into Kendall shape space, where translation, rotation, and scale are removed. We derive a multivariate geodesic regression with exact Riemannian gradients and use the fitted age-velocity field to localize age-related deformation to five anatomical sub-regions. In the cognitively normal cohort ($n = 252$), geodesic regression outperforms the Euclidean linear benchmark ($R^2 = 0.1355$ vs.\ $0.1216$). Regional energy is anterior-dominant: the Genu carries $46.1\%$ and the Anterior Body $23.3\%$ of total age-related shape change, together accounting for $\sim 69\%$ despite comprising only $\sim 41\%$ of landmarks. Signed projections confirm the ordering (Genu $r = 0.562$; Anterior Body $r = 0.507$). In contrast, age explains less than $0.5\%$ of shape variance in Alzheimer's disease ($n = 88$), indicating that the disease disrupts the healthy aging trajectory. A tangent-space classifier achieves an age-group AUC of $0.791$ from the 2D contour alone, exceeding a recent volumetric benchmark ($0.67$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Kendall形状空间的黎曼形状空间框架，对OASIS-1队列中矢状面胼胝体轮廓进行多元测地回归分析，将年龄相关形变定位到五个解剖子区域，并发现健康老化与阿尔茨海默病轨迹存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多使用标量摘要量化胼胝体，丢弃了其边界几何信息，无法精细刻画年龄相关的形态变化。
AI.method: 将128个标志点表示的轮廓嵌入Kendall形状空间（去除平移、旋转与尺度），推导具有精确黎曼梯度的多元测地回归，并利用拟合的年龄速度场将形变定位到五个解剖子区域，同时在切空间构建分类器。
AI.result: 在认知正常队列（n=252）中测地回归优于欧氏线性基准（R²=0.1355 vs. 0.1216）；区域能量呈前部主导，Genu占46.1%、Anterior Body占23.3%，合计约69%（仅占约41%标志点），符号投影确认排序（Genu r=0.562；Anterior Body r=0.507）；而阿尔茨海默病（n=88）中年龄仅解释不足0.5%的形状方差；切空间分类器仅用2D轮廓达到年龄组AUC 0.791，超过近期体积基准（0.67）。
AI.conclusion: 黎曼形状空间测地回归能有效捕捉并定位胼胝体年龄相关形态变化，前部子区域为主要形变区域，且阿尔茨海默病会破坏健康老化轨迹，二维轮廓分类亦具较高判别力。

title: WILLIE: A Unified Framework and Benchmark for Wound Classification, Segmentation, and Localization
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Published in Proceedings of the 11th Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference (MLHC 2026), PMLR 340:1243-1263. Code: https://github.com/Qian-Group-HRI/Willie
summary: Chronic wound management affects over 8.2 million patients in the United States and imposes substantial clinical and economic burden. Clinical wound assessment commonly involves three coupled tasks: identifying wound type, delineating wound boundaries, and localizing the wound region for measurement and monitoring. Despite this clinical coupling, existing machine learning approaches typically address wound classification, segmentation, and localization using separate models. We present WILLIE, a unified framework and benchmark for wound classification, segmentation and localization that enables systematic evaluation of multi-task wound analysis under a common protocol. WILLIE harmonizes three public wound datasets into a shared benchmark and compares unified models across three scaling configurations against 10 single-task baselines. The best model achieves 91.88% classification accuracy, 91.41% Dice, and 96.23% AP@0.5 while producing all three outputs in a single forward pass. Beyond aggregate performance, our results show that segmentation-derived localization outperforms dedicated detection baselines in this benchmark, suggesting that box-based localization may be unnecessary for spatially coherent wound targets. Our findings highlight that effective multi-task learning in healthcare imaging depends not only on shared representations, but also on task formulation, compatibility, and benchmark design.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出WILLIE统一框架与基准，将伤口分类、分割和定位三项任务整合，单次前向即可输出三结果，性能优于10个单任务基线。
AI.motivation: 慢性伤口管理影响美国逾820万患者，临床评估涉及伤口类型识别、边界勾画与区域定位三项相互耦合的任务，但现有机器学习方法通常用独立模型分别处理分类、分割与定位，缺乏统一评估协议，也难以系统考察多任务学习的可行性。
AI.method: 构建WILLIE统一框架与基准，将三个公开伤口数据集协调为共享基准；在统一协议下比较三种缩放配置的统一模型与10个单任务基线；以单次前向传播同时输出分类、分割与定位结果，并对比分割衍生定位与专用检测基线的表现。
AI.result: 最优模型取得91.88%分类准确率、91.41% Dice和96.23% AP@0.5，且三任务输出仅需一次前向传播；分割衍生的定位结果优于专用检测基线，表明对空间连贯的伤口目标而言基于边界框的定位可能并非必需。
AI.conclusion: 医疗影像中的有效多任务学习不仅依赖共享表征，还取决于任务形式化、任务兼容性与基准设计；WILLIE为多任务伤口分析提供了系统评估的统一协议。

title: IRSTD-Agent: Agentic Infrared Small Target Detection via Zoom-Guided Interaction Learning
summary: Infrared small-target detection plays an important role in maritime monitoring and aerial surveillance. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer promising capabilities for visual understanding, existing MLLM-based approaches struggle to precisely localize infrared small targets. In this paper, we propose IRSTD-Agent, an agentic framework for infrared small target detection through dynamic visual search. The framework enables an MLLM to adaptively determine where and at what scale to inspect an image and progressively gather fine-grained visual evidence for precise target localization. Five complementary visual tools (PROPOSAL, ZOOM, DETECT, DROP and REFINE) support object candidate discovery, adaptive observation, target localization, hypothesis rejection, and target extent refinement, together enabling a coordinated search process over original-resolution images. To teach the MLLMs to conduct this search, we introduce Zoom-guided Interaction Learning, which uses annotation-derived interaction trajectories to supervise tool selection and the corresponding arguments. Through extensive experiments on WideIRSTD-Full and IRSTD-1k datasets, we demonstrate that IRSTD-Agent outperforms the evaluated vision-language models and enhances the precise localization capabilities of MLLMs in IRSTD tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出IRSTD-Agent，一种通过动态视觉搜索实现红外小目标检测的智能体框架，让MLLM自适应决定检视位置与尺度并逐步收集细粒度视觉证据以精确定位目标。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标检测在海上监测与空中监视中至关重要。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）具备视觉理解潜力，但现有基于MLLM的方法难以精确定位红外小目标。
AI.method: 构建智能体框架，包含五个互补视觉工具：PROPOSAL（候选发现）、ZOOM（自适应观察）、DETECT（目标定位）、DROP（假设剔除）、REFINE（目标范围细化），协同支持在原始分辨率图像上的搜索。并引入Zoom引导的交互学习（Zoom-guided Interaction Learning），利用标注衍生的交互轨迹监督工具选择及其参数。
AI.result: 在WideIRSTD-Full与IRSTD-1k数据集上的大量实验表明，IRSTD-Agent优于所评估的视觉语言模型，并提升了MLLM在红外小目标检测任务中的精确定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 动态视觉搜索与工具协同的智能体范式能有效增强MLLM对红外小目标的精确定位，验证了交互学习监督的有效性。

title: MemStrata: 95% and 90.91% Source-Aware Accuracy on LongMemEval-500 and LoCoMo-1540 with a Local Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M Reader
comment: 29 pages, 23 tables, 1 figure. Ancillary files contain per-question grades and reproducible analyses, plus explicitly labelled exports from audited follow-up reports
summary: An adequate conversational answer may differ from a short or incomplete benchmark reference. To measure adequacy against the recorded history we prefer source-aware grading, in which the judge checks the reference against the full source before assessing system-blinded answers; original reference-only grading is reported alongside. With a local Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M reader and a 24,000-token evidence ceiling, MemStrata CL1 scores 475/500 (95.0%) on LongMemEval-S and 1,400/1,540 (90.91%) on LoCoMo categories 1-4 under source-aware GPT-5.5 adjudication, against 463/500 (92.6%) and 1,205/1,540 (78.25%) under reference-only grading of the same answers. It preserves a retrieval backbone and adds nonduplicated, dated, speaker-attributed source spans. A same-reader full-history control with about 4.7 times the evidence scores 464/500 reference-only and 470/500 (94.0%) source-aware; neither difference is decisive. Keyword-only selection at the same budget scores 425, and a matched-reader Letta arm 438. On LongMemEval-M, where the packet holds about 1.6% of each history, MemStrata CL1 scores 427/500, with losses concentrated in multi-session and temporal questions. On 300 BEAM-1M questions it outscores dense retrieval, 0.738 to 0.706 (Wilcoxon p = 0.011). A same-seed replay of unchanged requests changed 1.5-2.3% of labels. On identical packets GLM 5.3 flash is non-inferior within 3 points (462 versus 463); Muse Spark 1.3 did not show non-inferiority on 269 questions. None of four pre-registered interventions met all of its registered advancement or feasibility criteria. Signed read-side artifacts support inspection but do not regenerate the private retrieval pipeline. The superiority of source-aware grading to human adjudication is not established, and development exposure, automated-judge dependence and the absence of held-out data preclude an independent-replication or leaderboard claim.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"源感知评分"（source-aware grading）协议，并以MemStrata CL1记忆系统在LongMemEval、LoCoMo、BEAM-1M上验证：源感知评分下成绩显著高于仅参考评分，但差距未经决定性检验，且四项预注册干预均未达标，故不支持独立复现或排行榜式结论。
AI.motivation: 简短或不完整的基准参考难以评判对话式回答的"充分性"。作者认为，应让评判者在对照完整源文档校验参考后再评判系统盲测答案，以更真实地衡量系统与对话历史的一致性，同时保留原有仅参考评分作为对照。
AI.method: 定义源感知评分协议（评判前用完整源校验参考，并做系统盲评），与仅参考评分并列报告。系统MemStrata CL1在保留检索骨干的同时，加入去重、带日期、带说话人归属的源片段（span）。设置同一reader的全文历史对照（证据量约4.7倍）、同预算的关键词选择与Letta对照臂、同种子重放、同包多评判模型比较及四项预注册干预。
AI.result: LongMemEval-S：475/500（95.0%）源感知 vs 463/500（92.6%）仅参考；LoCoMo 1-4类：1,400/1,540（90.91%）vs 1,205/1,540（78.25%）。全文历史对照约4.7倍证据仅得464（仅参考）与470（源感知），差异不决定性；关键词选择425，Letta臂438。LongMemEval-M（包内约占1.6%历史）427/500，损失集中于多会话与时间类问题。BEAM-1M上300题优于稠密检索（0.738 vs 0.706，Wilcoxon p=0.011）。同种子重放改变1.5-2.3%标签；同包下GLM 5.3 flash非劣（462 vs 463），Muse Spark 1.3在269题上未显示非劣。
AI.conclusion: 源感知评分相对仅参考评分有明显账面优势，但系统与全文历史对照差异不决定性；四项预注册干预均未满足全部推进或可行性标准。作者明确声明：源感知评分优于人工裁定的说法尚未确立，且因开发集暴露、依赖自动评判和缺少留出数据，不能作独立复现或排行榜主张。签名的读取侧产物仅供检查，无法再生私有检索流程。

title: Learning Conditional Source Distribution via Flow Reversal for Temporal Flow Matching
summary: We introduce CNP-Flow, a flow matching framework for temporal generation that learns conditional source distributions through flow reversal. Whereas standard conditional flow matching (FM) incorporates conditioning through the vector field and draws source samples from a standard Gaussian, CNP-Flow uses a conditional noise predictor (CNP) to produce an isotropic Gaussian source for each temporal condition. The CNP is supervised by source samples obtained through flow reversal, which maps observed targets backward through a pretrained FM model. A three-stage pipeline pretrains the FM model, trains the CNP, and fine-tunes the FM model using the learned source distribution, while preserving the FM backbone architecture. Across video prediction, video interpolation, and 7-DoF Franka robot motion planning, CNP-Flow consistently improves generation quality. It also matches baseline performance with fewer function evaluations. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/cnpflow

AI.tldr: CNP-Flow 提出一种基于流反转学习条件源分布的流匹配框架，用条件噪声预测器为每个时间条件生成各向同性高斯源，在视频预测、插值和机器人运动规划任务中提升生成质量并减少函数评估次数。
AI.motivation: 标准条件流匹配（FM）仅通过向量场引入条件信息，源样本统一采自标准高斯分布，无法针对不同时间条件自适应地构造源分布，从而限制了条件生成的表达能力与效率。
AI.method: 提出 CNP-Flow：使用条件噪声预测器（CNP）为每个时间条件生成各向同性高斯源。CNP 通过流反转（flow reversal）获得监督信号，即将观测目标经预训练 FM 模型反向映射得到源样本。整体采用三阶段流水线：预训练 FM 模型、训练 CNP、再用学到的源分布微调 FM 模型，同时保持 FM 主干架构不变。
AI.result: 在视频预测、视频插值以及 7-DoF Franka 机器人运动规划任务上，CNP-Flow 一致地提升生成质量；同时以更少的函数评估次数匹配基线性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习条件化源分布而非固定高斯源，CNP-Flow 在保持 FM 主干结构的前提下有效改善了时序条件生成的质量与计算效率，适用于视频与机器人规划等多类时序生成任务。

title: FACET: Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport in High-Fidelity Fluorescence Microscopy Synthesis
summary: Fluorescence microscopy reveals where proteins localize, but only a limited number of proteins can be imaged in the same cell; generating these images from amino-acid sequence and the cell's morphological context enables in silico localization of unimaged proteins. The two conditions, however, play asymmetric roles: morphological context is spatially aligned with the target, whereas sequence is non-spatial and must specify protein-dependent localization within it, with recurring coarse patterns shared across proteins and finer protein-specific variation. Existing generators condition on both jointly, without separating what each explains. We introduce FACET (Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport), a probabilistic generative framework that encodes this structure as an explicit inductive bias: sequence semantics are learned from what context leaves unexplained, coarse localization regularities are shared across proteins through a semantic memory, and protein-specific variation is a bounded residual around them. A variance-preserving state projection further lets FACET perform continuous stochastic transport through a pretrained diffusion predictor with minimal parameter overhead. On held-out proteins, FACET improves spatial overlap by 34.3% on the Human Protein Atlas and 14.0% on OpenCell over a backbone-matched baseline, and reduces FID by 27.2% and 46.5%, respectively, with 75% fewer network evaluations. It also substantially improves protein-association structure recovery and yields better-calibrated predictions, while detailed ablations show complementary contributions from its design choices. These results identify factorized asymmetric conditioning, rather than generator capacity alone, as a key lever for high-fidelity, efficient, and biologically meaningful cellular image synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出FACET框架，通过因子化非对称条件建模，从氨基酸序列和细胞形态上下文生成未成像蛋白的荧光定位图像，在Human Protein Atlas和OpenCell上显著提升重叠度、FID并减少75%网络评估。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微成像只能同时观测有限数量的蛋白，希望借助序列与细胞形态上下文在计算上预测未成像蛋白的定位。但这两个条件是"非对称"的：形态上下文与目标空间对齐，而序列是非空间的，需要在其内部指定蛋白依赖的定位。已有生成器将两者联合条件化，未能分离各自解释的成分，因此需要引入显式的归纳偏置。
AI.method: 提出FACET（Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport），一个概率生成框架：序列语义从上下文未解释的部分中学习；跨蛋白共享的粗粒度定位规律通过语义记忆实现；蛋白特异变化建模为围绕共享规律的有界残差；并采用保方差的状态投影，使FACET能借助预训练扩散预测器进行连续随机传输，参数开销极小。
AI.result: 在留出蛋白上，FACET相比骨干匹配的基线，在Human Protein Atlas空间重叠提升34.3%，OpenCell提升14.0%；FID分别降低27.2%和46.5%，同时网络评估次数减少75%；蛋白关联结构恢复显著改善，预测校准更好；消融实验显示各设计选择具有互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，因子化非对称条件建模（而非单纯增大生成器容量）是高保真、高效且具有生物学意义的细胞图像合成的关键杠杆。

title: The ÌròyìnSpeech Text Corpus: 24,905 Curated Yorùbá Sentences for Speech and Language Technology
comment: 8 pages. Data descriptor for the ÌròyìnSpeech Text Corpus, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23138464. Under review at the Journal of Open Humanities Data. v3: added a note that the caron/circumflex contour-tone convention proposed in arXiv:2609.38627 has not been applied to the corpus
summary: ÌròyìnSpeech is a 42-hour, 80-speaker Yorùbá read-speech corpus whose audio has been distributed by ELRA since 2024. This paper describes the release of its text component: 24,905 unique, hand-verified, tone-marked Yorùbá sentences (275,897 tokens; 15,687 types), curated in 2022 as recording prompts. Roughly 11,000 sentences were adapted from openly licensed news material; the remainder were written in-house to broaden coverage beyond the religious translation that dominates existing Yorùbá corpora. Every sentence was checked by hand for tone-mark accuracy, edited for read-aloud clarity and a neutral register, and localised so that non-Yorùbá personal and place names appear in Yorùbá form. Preparing the text for release surfaced systematic Unicode normalisation failures affecting more than 60% of lines (with precomposed and decomposed forms of the same letter co-occurring within single sentences) which we document and correct. The corpus supports diacritic restoration, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, TTS front-end development and orthographic research, and serves as a validated prompt set for new recording.

AI.tldr: 发布ÌròyìnSpeech语音语料库的文本部分：24,905条手工校验、带声调符号的约鲁巴语句子，并记录与修正了影响60%以上语句的Unicode规范化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有约鲁巴语语料多集中于宗教翻译文本，覆盖面狭窄；且音频部分虽已于2024年由ELRA发布，但对应文本资源缺失。本文旨在公开经人工校验的文本组件，以拓宽语料领域覆盖并支持相关语言技术研究。
AI.method: 以2022年制作的录音提示语为基础，构建含80名说话人、42小时的朗读语音语料文本：约1.1万句改编自开放许可新闻材料，其余为内部撰写；逐句人工检查声调符号准确性，按朗读清晰度与中性语体进行编辑，并将非约鲁巴语人名地名本地化为约鲁巴语形式。
AI.result: 文本共24,905个唯一条目、275,897个词例、15,687个词型；发现并记录修正了超过60%语句存在的系统性Unicode规范化失败问题（同一句内出现同一字母的预组合与分解形式）。
AI.conclusion: 该文本资源可支持变音符号还原、字素到音素转换、TTS前端开发及正字法研究，并可作为新录音的已验证提示语集。

title: WiSPER: Pose-Supervised Predictive and Residual Flow Refinement For Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With WiFi CSI
summary: Multi-person 3D pose estimation with WiFi channel state information (CSI) is challenging because reflections from different people overlap without directly identifying individual joints. Existing masked embedding objectives capture wireless relationships without explicit pose supervision, while structured decoders can retain coordinate errors. We propose WiSPER, a two-stage framework combining pose-aware predictive pretraining with conditional residual flow refinement. Pose-Aware Masked Embedding Learning (PAMEL) couples masked latent prediction with auxiliary pose-set supervision on the same CSI context, guiding the encoder toward joint localization from partial observations. Residual Flow refinement with Transformer (ReFT) generates a set of pose candidates to accommodate a variable number of people and refines each candidate through a conditional flow guided by its coarse coordinates and per-joint decoder features. Both stages use paired CSI and pose annotations during training, while inference requires only CSI. Experiments on the PiW3D dataset show that WiSPER achieves an overall mean per-joint position error of 63.72 mm, a 40.0% reduction relative to WiFi-JEPA. For experiments with two and three people, WiSPER reduces MPJPE by 42.1% and 38.1%, respectively. Pose-supervised pretraining configurations obtain lower errors than CSI-only JEPA, and enabling the trained residual refiner reduces overall MPJPE by 13.8-15.6% across the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: WiSPER：两阶段WiFi CSI多人3D姿态估计框架，结合姿态感知掩码嵌入预训练与条件残差流细化，PiW3D上MPJPE降至63.72mm，较WiFi-JEPA降低40.0%。
AI.motivation: 基于WiFi CSI的多人3D姿态估计困难：不同人的反射信号相互重叠，无法直接区分个体关节。既有掩码嵌入目标虽能在无显式姿态监督下建模无线关系，但结构化解码器仍会残留坐标误差，导致定位精度受限。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架WiSPER。第一阶段PAMEL（姿态感知掩码嵌入学习）：在同一CSI上下文上耦合掩码隐变量预测与辅助姿态集合监督，引导编码器从部分观测中学习关节定位。第二阶段ReFT（Transformer残差流细化）：生成一组姿态候选以适配可变人数，并依据每个候选的粗坐标与逐关节解码器特征，通过条件流对候选进行细化。训练阶段使用配对的CSI与姿态标注，推理仅需CSI。
AI.result: 在PiW3D数据集上，WiSPER整体平均每关节位置误差为63.72 mm，相对WiFi-JEPA降低40.0%；两人和三人场景下MPJPE分别降低42.1%和38.1%。姿态监督预训练配置误差低于仅CSI的JEPA；启用训练后的残差细化器使整体MPJPE在各配置下降低13.8–15.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将姿态监督引入掩码嵌入预训练，并以条件残差流细化姿态候选，可有效缓解无线信号重叠与坐标误差残留问题，显著提升多人3D姿态估计精度，且推理阶段无需姿态标注。

title: Towards Unbiased On-Policy Distillation for Block Diffusion Language Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for language models, with recent efforts extending it to block diffusion language models (BDLMs). However, existing studies focus almost exclusively on small block sizes, leaving distillation into student models with larger blocks underexplored. In this work, we investigate this regime and reveal two critical optimization biases that induce severe training instability. First, mismatched block boundaries between teacher and student cause \textbf{\textit{context misalignment}}, providing distorted supervisory signals that misguide student decoding. Second, even under aligned contexts, an \textbf{\textit{intrinsic optimization bias}} in OPD, where the student tends to rapidly absorb high-support signals while lagging on low-support updates, drives a premature confidence surge that traps weaker students in catastrophic overconfidence collapse. To resolve these, we propose \mbox{\textbf{Un-OPD}}, an unbiased on-policy distillation framework with two novelties for stabilizing BDLM training. First, Un-OPD introduces a boundary-aware step filtering strategy that eliminates context-misaligned decoding steps. Second, Un-OPD proposes moderating optimization intensity at high-support positions via a support-rebalanced confidence calibration, thereby bypassing overconfidence collapse. Beyond stability, we also introduce a rollout reuse mechanism to reduce rollout generation overhead. Extensive experiments on math reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Un-OPD consistently stabilizes training and delivers superior performance while reducing wall-clock training time by approximately half.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大块大小块扩散语言模型（BDLM）的在线策略蒸馏（OPD），揭示了上下文错位与内在优化偏置两类导致训练不稳定的问题，提出无偏蒸馏框架Un-OPD，实现稳定训练并将训练时间缩短约一半。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD研究几乎只关注小块大小，忽视了大块学生模型的蒸馏。在该场景下存在两个严重优化偏置：教师与学生块边界不一致导致的上下文错位，产生失真监督；以及OPD内在优化偏置，使学生快速吸收高支持信号而低支持更新滞后，引发过早置信飙升，最终导致弱学生陷入灾难性过自信崩溃。
AI.method: 提出Un-OPD无偏在线策略蒸馏框架，包含两项创新：1）边界感知步过滤策略，剔除上下文错位的解码步；2）支持重平衡的置信度校准，通过调节高支持位置的优化强度来规避过度自信崩溃。此外引入rollout复用机制以降低rollout生成开销。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成基准上，Un-OPD持续稳定训练并取得更优性能，同时将墙钟训练时间减少约一半。
AI.conclusion: Un-OPD有效解决了大块BDLM在线策略蒸馏中的不稳定与偏置问题，兼顾训练稳定性、性能提升与效率，为块扩散语言模型的后训练提供了可行的无偏蒸馏方案。

title: VHDL-REPOBENCH: A Repository-Level Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on VHDL Design Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in hardware design automation, demonstrating strong potential in generating and understanding hardware description languages. However, most existing benchmarks focus on Verilog, with limited evaluation of VHDL, which remains widely used in industry and academia for FPGA and safety-critical systems. To address this gap, we introduce VHDL-REPOBENCH, a large-scale, cross-file, repository-level benchmark for assessing LLM capabilities on realistic VHDL design generation and analysis tasks. VHDL-REPOBENCH curates ~100 open-source VHDL repositories, encompassing ~2.5k VHDL files and ~500 testbenches, and provides structured problem statements, module stubs, and self-verifying testbenches. The benchmark enables comprehensive evaluation across syntax, semantic correctness, hierarchical reasoning, cross-file dependency resolution, and functional verification. We evaluate several state-of-the-art models, including GPT-4o, Llama-3-70B, Qwen2.5-72B, CodeLlama-70B, and multi-step reasoning approaches such as Reflexion and CoDes. Results reveal that while current LLMs achieve moderate line- and block-level accuracy, substantial challenges remain in multi-file reasoning, hierarchical design understanding, and specification-to-module generation. VHDL-REPOBENCH represents the first large-scale VHDL-focused benchmark and provides a valuable resource for the hardware design community to evaluate, compare, and advance LLM capabilities for practical VHDL development.

AI.tldr: 提出VHDL-REPOBENCH，首个大规模、跨文件、仓库级VHDL基准，用于评估大语言模型在真实VHDL设计生成与分析任务中的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM硬件设计基准多聚焦Verilog，对仍广泛用于FPGA及安全关键系统的VHDL评估不足，缺乏面向真实仓库级VHDL任务的评测资源。
AI.method: 构建VHDL-REPOBENCH基准，整理约100个开源VHDL仓库、约2.5k个VHDL文件及约500个测试平台，提供结构化问题陈述、模块桩和自验证测试平台；从语法、语义正确性、层次化推理、跨文件依赖解析和功能验证等维度评测GPT-4o、Llama-3-70B、Qwen2.5-72B、CodeLlama-70B及Reflexion、CoDes等多步推理方法。
AI.result: 当前LLM在行级和块级准确率上达到中等水平，但在多文件推理、层次化设计理解以及规范到模块生成方面仍面临显著挑战。
AI.conclusion: VHDL-REPOBENCH是首个大规模VHDL专用基准，为硬件设计社区评估、比较和推进LLM在实用VHDL开发中的能力提供了宝贵资源。

title: Harness-Search: Guiding Long-Horizon Search through Multi-Agent Coordination
summary: Long-horizon search requires agents to gather evidence across multiple steps and synthesize it into well-supported answers. The recent agent harnesses provide a natural and promising framework to support such long-running search processes. As interaction histories grow, one single agent in harnesses might get stuck and cause the policy to lose track of unresolved questions, overlook useful evidence, or terminate before sufficient support has been collected. One of promising way is to decouple three distinct responsibilities of proposing retrieval actions, updating persistent state, and deciding when to stop rather than concentrating them within a single policy. Targeted at it, we introduce Harness-Search, a multi-agent search harness to reduce the local errors propagating across subsequent exploration, evidence curation, and termination decisions. In particular, Harness-Search assigns these responsibilities to three permission-bounded authorities: a Retrieval Policy that proposes search operations, a Memory Operator that validates and commits persistent-state updates, and a Summary Auditor that accepts or rejects termination based on the sufficiency of the curated evidence. Together, these roles form a Propose-Commit-Audit loop in which actions are proposed, persistent evidence is selectively committed, and stopping decisions are subjected to an explicit sufficiency check.
