summary: Echocardiography is the most widely used cardiac imaging modality, yet interpretation demands integrating visual evidence across global anatomy, localized structures and dynamic cardiac motion. Machine-learning models have automated individual tasks, but they are typically built for a single purpose and depend on expensively labeled datasets - a barrier particularly acute in pediatric care, where data are scarce and anatomy changes with age. Here we present EchoDino, a self-supervised foundation model for echocardiography, created by adapting the DINOv3 framework to 3.7 million frames from 1.7 million unlabeled pediatric echocardiography videos. With its encoder frozen, EchoDino produces representations that capture global context, local anatomy, and dense spatial detail. We introduce Motion-biased Entropy Maximization Sampling (MEMS) to select the most informative frames for video-level analysis. Across nine pediatric and adult datasets, EchoDino outperformed strong baseline models, raising view-classification accuracy from 0.609 to 0.889 and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for structural-heart-disease detection from 0.811 to 0.872, while also cutting age-estimation error from 3.857 to 1.389 years, achieving the best segmentation accuracy and lowering ejection-fraction errors. By generalizing from label-free pediatric data to adult echocardiography, EchoDino offers a versatile foundation for cardiac image analysis across the lifespan.

AI.tldr: EchoDino：基于DINOv3自监督范式、在170万例无标注儿科超声心动图视频（370万帧）上训练的心脏超声基础模型；冻结编码器即可同时捕捉全局、局部与密集空间表征，并配合MEMS采样完成视频级分析，在儿科与成人共9个数据集上全面超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图是最常用的心脏影像模态，但判读需整合整体解剖、局部结构与动态运动信息，难度高。现有机器学习模型多针对单一任务、依赖昂贵标注数据；在儿科场景中数据稀缺且解剖结构随年龄变化，标注瓶颈尤为突出。因此需要一个能跨任务、跨年龄段泛化且无需大量标注的基础模型。
AI.method: 将DINOv3自监督框架适配到心脏超声领域，构建EchoDino基础模型：训练语料为170万段无标注儿科超声心动图视频、共370万帧。模型编码器冻结后即可输出兼顾全局上下文、局部解剖与密集空间细节的表征。同时提出Motion-biased Entropy Maximization Sampling（MEMS），用于为视频级分析挑选信息量最高的帧。
AI.result: 在9个儿科与成人数据集上，EchoDino优于强基线：视角分类准确率由0.609提升至0.889；结构性心脏病检测AUC由0.811提升至0.872；年龄估计误差由3.857年降至1.389年；分割精度达到最优，射血分数误差亦降低。
AI.conclusion: EchoDino证明可从无标注儿科数据出发，泛化至成人超声心动图，为覆盖全生命周期的通用心脏图像分析提供了基础模型范式，缓解了儿科数据稀缺与标注昂贵的问题。

title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
comment: Technical report on the open-source T2AV model. GitHub: https://github.com/kandinskylab/kandinsky-6
summary: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920$\times$1080). Building on the video generation capabilities of Kandinsky 5.0, Kandinsky 6.0 Video employs a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that connects a pretrained video stream and a newly trained audio stream through bidirectional cross-attention for temporal and semantic alignment. Our continuous pretraining strategy first trains the audio stream from scratch on large-scale audio corpora and then trains both streams jointly on paired audio-video data while preserving unimodal fidelity; pretraining is followed by supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning-based post-training, and distillation. In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality. To accelerate open research and deployment in multimedia generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.

AI.tldr: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 系列基础扩散模型实现文/图到音视频同步生成，含 3B Lite 与 29B Pro 两版，通过双流 CrossDiT 与连续预训练策略产出 5 秒 44kHz 同步音视频并可超分至全高清。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频生成模型在语音质量与时序/语义对齐方面仍有不足，且缺乏开源可复现的强基线。作者希望构建统一的基础模型，实现高质量、同步的文本/图像到音视频生成，并推动多媒体生成领域的开放研究。
AI.method: 提出 Kandinsky 6.0 Video 系列（3B Lite、29B Pro）。采用双流 CrossDiT 架构，将预训练视频流与新训练音频流通过双向交叉注意力连接，实现时序与语义对齐。训练流程为连续预训练：先在音频语料上从零训练音频流，再在配对音视频数据上联合训练双流，同时保持单模态保真度；之后进行监督微调、基于强化学习的后训练与蒸馏。支持 T2AV 与 I2AV 模式，内置超分模型将输出提升至 1920×1080。
AI.result: 模型可生成 5 秒视频及同步 44kHz 音频（含口型同步），输出分辨率可达全高清。人工并排评测中，Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro 明显优于前代 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，并在语音质量方面与领先的音视频生成模型保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 在同步音视频生成上取得显著进展，兼顾质量与对齐，并提供开源代码、模型权重与 diffusers 集成（MIT 许可），以加速多媒体生成的研究与部署。

title: DREAM: Dynamic Resolution Assignment For Multimodal Multi-agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) has emerged as an effective paradigm to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and is increasingly being extended to multimodal settings. However, existing multimodal MAD frameworks typically expose agents to the same fixed visual input, ignoring substantial variation in the visual scale needed across samples and agents. In addition, these frameworks frequently suffer from groupthink, a phenomenon where agents prematurely abandon correct deductions to conform with confident but hallucinated peer responses. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce DREAM (Dynamic Resolution Assignment For Multimodal Multi-Agent Debate), which operates via two core components: (1) Dynamic Resolution Assignment, a zero-shot probe round where agents test multiple resolutions, quantify uncertainty using Average Normalized Log-Likelihood (ANLL), and use an adaptive threshold to assign each agent to its empirically optimal resolution; (2) Uncertainty-Guided Rollback Aggregation counters groupthink by tracking each agent's uncertainty over rounds and restoring early low-uncertainty answers overridden by group pressure. On six multimodal datasets, DREAM improves the accuracy-token trade-off over multi-agent debate baselines by 1.5-3.2% accuracy without dataset-specific tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出DREAM框架，通过动态分辨率分配与不确定性引导回滚聚合两项组件，缓解多模态多智能体辩论中视觉尺度固定与群体思维问题，在六个数据集上以更优token代价提升1.5-3.2%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态MAD框架让所有智能体共享同一固定视觉输入，忽视了不同样本与智能体对视觉尺度需求的显著差异；同时易出现群体思维，即智能体在同伴自信但幻觉化的回答压力下过早放弃正确推理。
AI.method: DREAM包含两个核心组件：（1）动态分辨率分配，采用零样本探针轮，智能体测试多种分辨率并用平均归一化对数似然（ANLL）量化不确定性，借助自适应阈值将各智能体分配到经验最优分辨率；（2）不确定性引导回滚聚合，通过跟踪各智能体多轮不确定性，恢复被群体压力覆盖的早期低不确定性答案，以对抗群体思维。
AI.result: 在六个多模态数据集上，无需针对数据集调参，DREAM相较现有多智能体辩论基线在准确率—token权衡上取得1.5-3.2%的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: DREAM通过将分辨率自适应分配与不确定性驱动的答案回滚相结合，有效缓解多模态MAD的固定视觉输入与群体思维瓶颈，在多个数据集上实现了更优的精度—效率平衡，且具备良好的免调参泛化性。

title: Atomic Visual Entailment: Enhancing Zero-Shot Vision-Language Reasoning through Atomic Fact Decomposition and Learned Selection
summary: Visual entailment (VE) asks whether an image supports, contradicts, or leaves undecided a textual hypothesis. Strong results come from fine-tuning large vision-language models on labelled data, while zero-shot and hybrid approaches remain far behind. A VE hypothesis often bundles several visual claims, yet existing zero-shot methods reason over it as a single unit. We propose Atomic Visual Entailment (AVE), which decomposes the hypothesis into atomic facts, produces candidate predictions from both the full hypothesis and its facts using frozen vision-language models, and predicts the final label with a lightweight classifier trained only on how those candidates behave. We find that decomposition helps only when the hypothesis context is preserved: judging facts in isolation is worse than not decomposing at all. Full-hypothesis and atomic prediction make complementary errors, and learning which to trust recovers far more of that complementarity than majority voting, reaching 0.803 test accuracy on SNLI-VE without fine-tuning any vision-language model. AVE also localises the visual evidence behind its prediction without region-level supervision. These results suggest that learning which candidate prediction to trust can close much of the gap to fine-tuned systems, offering a practical alternative where fine-tuning a vision-language model directly would need more labelled data or compute than is available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Atomic Visual Entailment (AVE)，将视觉蕴含假设拆解为原子事实，并结合完整假设与原子事实的候选预测，用轻量分类器决定最终标签，在SNLI-VE上无需微调视觉语言模型即达到0.803测试准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉蕴含任务中，强结果依赖对大型视觉语言模型的微调，而零样本与混合方法差距明显；且既有零样本方法将包含多个视觉主张的假设作为单一单元推理，忽略了其组合结构。
AI.method: 提出AVE（Atomic Visual Entailment）：将假设分解为原子事实，利用冻结的视觉语言模型分别基于完整假设和原子事实生成候选预测，再用仅在候选预测行为特征上训练的轻量分类器预测最终标签。
AI.result: 分解仅在保留假设上下文时有效，孤立判断原子事实比不分解更差；完整假设预测与原子预测误差互补，学习信任哪一方比多数投票恢复更多互补性，在SNLI-VE上达到0.803测试准确率；此外AVE无需区域级监督即可定位支持预测的视觉证据。
AI.conclusion: 学习信任哪一候选预测可大幅缩小与微调系统的差距，为缺乏标注数据或算力的场景提供了一种无需微调视觉语言模型的实用替代方案。
